Her longstanding commitment to medical education has contributed to the development of generations of dermatologists in Thailand and to advancing training standards within one of the country’s leading medical institutions.

Dr. Nantapat is also one of the co-founders of the ITCAM Dermatologic Society Thailand, a professional organization dedicated to promoting clinical knowledge, research, and the exchange of best practices in both medical and aesthetic dermatology throughout Thailand.
In 1995, she founded Apex Medical Center, which under her leadership has grown into a network of modern aesthetic and dermatology clinics.

At Apex, Dr. Nantapat has taken a leading role in developing and establishing treatment protocols across a broad range of advanced technologies. These include various laser systems, such as Pico lasers, Q-Switched Nd:YAG lasers, CO₂ fractional lasers, and erbium lasers; radiofrequency technologies such as Thermage; radiofrequency microneedling technologies including Sylfirm and Morpheus; focused ultrasound technology such as Ulthera; and injectable treatments including botulinum toxin, hyaluronic acid fillers, and collagen-stimulating injectables. These treatment protocols are designed with an emphasis on efficacy, safety, and natural-looking outcomes for a wide range of patients.

With expertise recognized internationally, Dr. Nantapat has been invited to serve as an advisor to leading pharmaceutical companies and manufacturers of aesthetic medical devices, including Allergan, Merz, and leading laser technology companies. In these roles, she has provided strategic consultation on product development, clinical research design, and professional training programs for physicians in Thailand and internationally.

From 1995 to the present, Dr. Nantapat has been regularly invited to chair conferences and workshops in dermatologic surgery and aesthetic medicine at both national and international levels. She has also served as a speaker and live demonstrator of advanced treatment techniques at conferences attended by medical professionals from countries across Asia, Europe, and the Americas.

Beyond her clinical and academic roles, Dr. Nantapat remains committed to mentoring and advising younger generations of physicians and continues to contribute to the advancement of the profession through both national and international professional organizations. She works closely with colleagues in Thailand and abroad to exchange clinical knowledge and support the continued development of dermatology.

Fluent in both Thai and English, Dr. Nantapat continues to play an important role in translating research-based knowledge into practical clinical applications, with the goal of improving patient outcomes and maintaining high standards of care across every aspect of her work.

Her longstanding dedication to research, education, and the development of advanced treatment approaches has established her as one of Thailand’s leading figures in aesthetic innovation and dermatologic surgery.

post:breast-augmentation-guide.title: What Is Breast Augmentation? Popular Silicone Techniques and Prices Before You Decide (2025)
post:breast-augmentation-guide.author: oraya choeipho

blocks.x: Is breast augmentation a good idea? Everything you need to know: popular silicone implants, techniques, precautions and the latest prices before you decide, with tips for choosing a clinic safely.

Breast augmentation is one of the most popular cosmetic surgeries, among women, LGBTQA+ people and people who have lost a breast to disease or an accident. The breasts are a part of the body and also a part of confidence and self-expression.

Many people choose breast augmentation to feel more confident in what they wear, so that clothes fit and look better. Others choose it to fulfill a dream of who they want to be, whether in appearance, femininity or inner feeling.

However, breast augmentation is major surgery. Even with more advanced technology, it still carries risks you should know about. This article explains breast augmentation from every side to help you make your decision.
Who Is Breast Augmentation Suitable For?
In general, breast augmentation for women and LGBTQA+ people aims to build confidence and correct problems with breast shape. It is suitable for the following groups.

items.x: Women with small or asymmetrical breasts
Women who want to feel more confident
People with sagging breasts, or breasts that have become smaller because of changes in the body

blocks.x: Breast augmentation also has limits for some people. The groups who should avoid it include:

items.x: People with health conditions that require regular medication, such as high blood pressure, diabetes or immune system problems
People with a family history of breast cancer
People who are pregnant or breastfeeding
People with very little breast tissue, to the point that a doctor does not recommend augmentation

blocks.x: Breast Augmentation Techniques
Several breast augmentation techniques have been developed, and each suits a different type of breast, as follows.
1. Over the Muscle
The implant is placed entirely on top of the muscle layer, which keeps the implant from touching the chest skin directly. This technique suits people with a fairly large amount of breast tissue.
2. Under the Muscle

This is the most popular breast augmentation technique, since it gives the breast a good shape and a firm look, and it also lowers the chance of scar tissue forming. This technique suits people with thin breast tissue. Sagging breasts may need a breast lift as well.
3. Partly Under the Muscle (Dual Plane Technique)

The upper half of the implant sits under the muscle and the lower half sits over it. It combines the advantages of both techniques above, so the result looks like a natural breast, does not look too firm, and further reduces the chance of scar tissue forming.
Types of Breast Implants
Breast implants come in several types to meet different needs. The popular ones are:
1. Round Implants

A round implant resembles a perfect ball and gives fullness from the upper chest down to the lower breast. Its wide base suits people with broad shoulders. Breast augmentation with a round implant makes the breasts visibly larger.
2. Teardrop Implants

A teardrop implant imitates the shape of a natural breast, with a slight droop under gravity, so it suits people with narrow shoulders and a tall frame. Breast augmentation with this shape makes the breasts look proportionate and in harmony with the existing figure. It suits people who want a small increase in size or a lifted shape that fits well.
Implants are also divided by surface texture: smooth, textured, or semi-smooth and semi-textured.
What Are the Popular Breast Implants?
Two implant brands are popular at present: Mentor and Motiva.
Mentor Implants

Mentor is an implant brand that has been popular for more than 40 years. Its manufacturer is part of Johnson & Johnson MedTech, and the implants are approved by the US FDA. The highlight is its Cohesive Gel, which is firm, dense and consistent, so it feels and looks like the real thing. This gel is exclusive to Mentor. Surgeons commonly use three Mentor models:

items.x: Smooth Round: a round implant with a wide base and a smooth surface. It is widely popular since it corrects sagging breasts well.
MemoryGel Xtra: a teardrop implant developed from the Smooth Round. It stands out for its gel volume, the thickness of the shell and a surface that feels more realistic.
MemoryGel Xtra Ultimate: the newest Mentor implant. It stands out for a surface that feels like real breast tissue and for moving with the body. It is designed and made in the United States.

blocks.x: Motiva Implants

Motiva is another popular brand in breast surgery. Its implants are a new innovation, developed so that the gel and the shell feel like real breast tissue and the breast moves realistically, in keeping with the human body. Three Motiva models are popular at present:

items.x: Motiva Silk Surface: this model is divided into Silk Surface Plus, which is round, and Silk Surface Ergonomix, which is semi-teardrop. Both have a Nano Texture surface that feels soft, similar to a real breast, and helps reduce scar tissue formation. Silk Surface Ergonomix also has a small data chip inside the implant, so its details can be checked with a scanner designed specifically for Motiva.
Motiva Ergonomix: designed to move realistically, so in different positions the implant adjusts to the movement of the body and does not look too firm.

Motiva Joy: the newest model, designed and developed by a research team. Its special feature is a shell with up to 6 layers, which helps protect against rupture, leakage and tearing and makes it stronger, while it stays highly flexible and feels more like a real breast than earlier models.

blocks.x: What Are the Steps of Breast Augmentation?

Breast augmentation must be performed by a surgeon who specializes in it, and it takes about 1 to 2 hours. Before surgery the patient receives general anesthesia. The doctor then makes an incision under the breast fold, around the nipple or, in some cases, in the armpit. The doctor creates a pocket in the breast tissue large enough for the implant and inserts the implant into it. The implant is sterile and strong.
Recovery After Breast Augmentation

After surgery, the patient wears a compression bra for several weeks to support the breasts and reduce swelling. The doctor prescribes pain medication to ease pain and discomfort. In general, patients can return to normal life in 1 to 2 weeks but must avoid exertion and large movements. Exercise is allowed after another 4 to 6 weeks.
What Are the Results of Breast Augmentation?

Results of breast augmentation may vary from person to person. In general, patients see the full result within 3 to 6 months after surgery, since some slight swelling may remain until then. The shape and feel of the augmented breast follow the implant that was chosen.
Risks and Complications of Breast Augmentation
Like every type of surgery, breast augmentation carries risks and possible complications. The most common are:

items.x: Infection
Bleeding
Scar tissue formation
Leakage or rupture of the implant
Dissatisfaction with the result

blocks.x: What to Consider Before Breast Augmentation

Before deciding on breast augmentation, there are several important points to weigh: your expectations, your health, your budget, and an understanding of the risks and complications that may occur. Choosing a surgery clinic and an experienced surgical team is also important, since an expert team gives patients confidence that the surgery will proceed with care.
How Much Does Breast Augmentation Cost?

The cost of breast augmentation varies with several factors, such as the type of implant, the various treatment costs, the surgeon who performs the operation and the clinic you choose. Breast augmentation is not a surgery to choose on low price, since a price that is too low may mean a risk of counterfeit implants or a higher risk of complications, and it can endanger life.

blocks.x: Khun Mol faced a problem that weighed on her: she had breast tissue but lacked a rounded, beautiful upper curve. This flat chest with no curve left her very short on confidence in clothes that show off her figure, especially a bikini. She decided to consult a surgeon and choose breast augmentation. Here is Khun Mol's complete Motiva Joy breast augmentation review, shared for anyone who is interested.
Khun Mol and Her Lack of Confidence: Breast Tissue but No Curve

For Khun Mol, her breasts were an obstacle to confidence in clothes, especially outfits that show the figure. The main problem was the lack of a rounded, beautiful curve. "I had never had breast augmentation before, and I felt that, as you can see, clothes still didn't look good on me. I looked flat, something like that."

Khun Mol described the specific problem that led her to consult a surgeon about making her breasts look better shaped. "I have breast tissue but no curve. Whatever I wear, I lack confidence, because there is no curve at all. When I wear a bikini or an outfit that shows the chest or anything like it, it makes me feel less confident."
Khun Mol's Goal After Breast Augmentation

Khun Mol wanted breasts that look sexier, with a beautiful curve, neither too large nor too small, so that they stay balanced and natural. "What I want for my breasts after the procedure is for them to look neither too small nor too big, to look sexier and to have a beautiful curve."
Consultation Before Deciding on Breast Augmentation

Khun Mol decided to consult Dr. Somboon, and she was impressed by his professionalism and the detail of his advice. "Dr. Somboon gives very good advice and measures in great detail, whether it is the implant itself, the size or the dimensions. He can answer every question."
Choosing the Implant and Using the Simulation Program
For the implant, Khun Mol chose Motiva Joy, which is known for its softness and natural feel. "The implant I chose is Motiva Joy. After I touched it, I can tell you it is very soft."

The simulation program also made her decision easier, since it let Khun Mol see the result of breast augmentation more clearly. "Here they have a breast simulation program that shows before and after, so you can see roughly how it will turn out. The doctor showed it to me too, and it looked very beautiful. I could see what I would get after augmentation."
After Surgery: Fast Recovery and Feeling Better After 7 Days

Khun Mol said the first week after surgery needed extra care, but after the first 7 days the pain went down fairly quickly. "It doesn't hurt anymore. There is a little sharp twinge, but days 1 to 7 are much worse. Once you get past 7 days, it's very easy."
The Result After Breast Augmentation: A Beautiful Shape and a Small Scar

One month after breast augmentation, Khun Mol was satisfied with the result, especially the natural feel of the Motiva Joy implant. "I can tell you I like how I feel after the procedure very much. The implant I chose gives a natural look."
Besides the natural softness, Khun Mol was especially impressed by how small the incision scar is, smaller than she first expected. "The scar is quite small. You can hardly see it."

Khun Mol added that her breasts are gradually settling into a more natural droop, and she expects them to look even better as time goes on. "Everything is normal. Now they are starting to settle and look more and more natural."

Khun Mol's breast augmentation corrected the long-standing body concern of "breast tissue but no curve" that had cost her confidence. It also delivered the result she wanted: sexy, beautiful breasts with a well-proportioned curve and a natural look, with Motiva Joy implants.

post:deep-plane-face-lift.title: Reveal Youthful, Wrinkle-Free Skin with Facelift Techniques
post:deep-plane-face-lift.author: oraya choeipho

blocks.x: People say that wrinkles on the face are traces of experience, but few people want those traces to be very visible. For that reason, many ways of keeping facial skin youthful have become popular: treatments, skincare products and the facelift, which is widely popular today. This article introduces the facelift and explains why it is so popular.
What Is a Facelift?

A facelift is facial cosmetic surgery that aims to correct wrinkles, sagging and excess fat on the face. The doctor operates to lift and tighten the muscles and tissue beneath the skin and removes excess skin, so the face looks more youthful.
Why Is the Facelift So Popular?
The facelift is very popular today for several reasons.

items.x: Clear results: a facelift targets wrinkles, sagging and excess fat on the face directly, so the face looks visibly more youthful in a short time.
Long-lasting results: a deep plane facelift can keep results for about 7 to 12 years, depending on the technique used, the care taken after surgery and each person's skin condition.
Safe: many facelift techniques today focus on safety, small incisions and fast recovery, which makes it easier for people to decide to correct their concerns with a facelift.

blocks.x: Who Is the Facelift Suitable For?

In general, a facelift suits people aged 40 and over who have wrinkles and sagging skin on the lower face and neck. Whether a facelift is possible depends on the doctor's judgment rather than on age alone. The doctor considers the following:

items.x: Deep wrinkles around the cheek lines, the corners of the mouth and the neck
Sagging skin that has lost firmness
Fat buildup on the cheeks and under the chin
A face that looks older than your age

blocks.x: What Are the Facelift Techniques?

With advances in medical technology, there are now quite a few facelift techniques, and each one addresses sagging facial skin differently. The doctor chooses the method that suits each person's problem and needs. The popular facelift techniques at present are:

items.x: High SMAS Facelift: this technique sutures and lifts the SMAS (Superficial Musculoaponeurotic System), a layer of tissue deep under the skin, so the result lasts longer.
Deep Plane Facelift: a facelift technique that focuses on lifting and tightening the deep muscle layer. It corrects deep wrinkles and sagging effectively.
MACS Lift (Minimal Access Cranial Suspension Lift): this technique uses small incisions at the temples and shortens recovery time. It suits people with milder wrinkles.

blocks.x: Preparing for a Facelift
Once you decide on a facelift, preparation matters. Before the facelift, you should:

items.x: Consult a specialist plastic surgeon experienced in facelifts to assess your concerns and plan the treatment
Tell the doctor about drug allergies, underlying conditions and the medications you take regularly
Stop smoking and drinking alcohol for at least 2 weeks
Stop certain medications and supplements as the doctor advises

blocks.x: Caring for Yourself After a Facelift
A facelift is a surgical operation, so after it you need to follow the doctor's instructions strictly to help the wounds heal faster and reduce the risk of complications. You should:

items.x: Apply cold compresses to the surgical area regularly to reduce swelling
Take medication strictly as prescribed
Sleep with your head raised on high pillows to reduce swelling
Avoid bending your head down and lifting heavy objects
Avoid strenuous exercise for a while
Clean the wounds regularly and apply medication as the doctor prescribes
Attend follow-up appointments

blocks.x: Facelift Results

In general, the results of a facelift become clearly visible once the wounds have fully healed, which takes about 1 to 3 months. The face looks more youthful, wrinkles fade and the skin looks firm. Results can last about 7 to 12 years, depending on the technique used, the care taken after surgery and each person's skin condition.

post:deep-plane-facelift-review-by-dy.title: Deep Plane Facelift Program Review from Khun Dy Patthama
post:deep-plane-facelift-review-by-dy.author: Apex Surgery Team

blocks.x: Khun Dy was afraid of cosmetic surgery, but as the skin on her face showed more signs of age, taking serious care of herself became unavoidable. This article shares Khun Dy Patthama's firsthand experience of a significant facelift that turned her worry back into confidence.
Why She Chose a Facelift Program Despite Her Fear of Cosmetic Surgery

To be honest, I was quite afraid of cosmetic surgery. I first thought about having something done around the age of 50 because I was starting to worry about the area under my eyes, but I could never bring myself to decide. My daughter also was reluctant for me to do it, so time kept passing.

Now I am 57 (at the time of my facelift program) and I can clearly feel that the problems have increased a lot, especially on my neck, which has aged faster than other Thai women my age. Perhaps because I am of mixed heritage, my skin shows age sooner than my friends'. When I looked in the mirror, I felt that if I was going to do it, I wanted to finish everything in one go and treat the whole face. I researched facelifts in Thailand and abroad until I found Dr. Somboon Waiphrip (license no. 22713) at Apex. After the consultation I was comfortable trusting him, and my daughter was fine with it too, so I decided to go ahead.
What Were the Results at 3 Stages?
After 17 Days

At 17 days (December 23, 2024), I'll be honest: my face still had some swelling and bruising, especially around the cheeks and jawline, and there were still scars behind my ears. My face didn't look settled yet, but makeup covered it, and I could go out and live my daily life normally. I didn't feel I had to hide or cover my face all the time.
After 1 Month

Personally, I felt my wounds started healing well within the first 7 days. By 1 month the surgical scars were almost invisible, and if I didn't say anything, nobody would know I'd had a facelift. When I go out I no longer worry that someone will notice the scars. Most of the swelling had gone down, and my face looked more settled and more natural by the day.
After 3 Months

post:double-eyelid-surgery-facts.title: 7 Facts Worth Knowing About Double Eyelid Surgery
post:double-eyelid-surgery-facts.author: oraya choeipho

blocks.x: Double eyelid surgery is one of the most popular procedures in cosmetic surgery, especially in Asian countries, since the eyelid crease is a key element that strongly shapes the overall look of the face.

Eyes with a clear crease often look brighter, younger and more attractive, while some people have drooping eyelids, uneven creases or no clear crease, which can affect their personality and presence and, in some cases, their vision.
In this article we introduce "5 real facts" that many people may not know about double eyelid surgery, along with how to prepare and which options lead to a safe and satisfying result.
1. The Surgery Takes Less Time Than You Think
Many people think eye surgery takes a long time, but double eyelid surgery generally takes only 30 to 60 minutes, depending on the technique used and how complex the eyelid problem is.

Double eyelid surgery comes in incisional and non-incisional forms. For some people who have a single eyelid and want to add a natural crease, the "point stitching" technique needs no incision at all, which takes less time and has a somewhat shorter recovery than incisional double eyelid surgery.
2. There Are Several Surgical Methods to Choose From
Double eyelid surgery has been developed into many methods, which address eyelid problems more effectively. They are:

items.x: Non-incisional: sutures form the crease without cutting the skin. It suits people with thin eyelid skin and little fat.
Mini-incision: a small incision at selected points. It suits people who want a minor correction.
Full-incision: it suits people with sagging eyelid skin and a lot of fat buildup who want to correct both the structure of the crease and the eyelid skin.
Hybrid: techniques used together to fit the characteristics of each person's eyes.

blocks.x: However, the surgeon decides which technique is most suitable for the patient, to give the result that fits the patient best.
3. It Serves Purposes Beyond Appearance
Most people choose double eyelid surgery for beauty. In fact, eye surgery can also solve problems that affect quality of life, such as:

items.x: Drooping eyelids from aging or excess eyelid skin, which can fall far enough to block vision
Weak eyelid muscles (Ptosis), which make the eyes look sleepy or dull and can also block vision
Thick eyelids or uneven creases, which can make makeup not hold or the eyes look unbalanced

blocks.x: Double eyelid surgery of this kind improves quality of life and builds confidence for people who live with these problems.
4. Low Chance of Scarring
Surgical technology has advanced a great deal. The operation is highly precise and uses small instruments, so the wounds are small and are often hidden in the fold of the eyelid.
Suturing techniques and aftercare also reduce the risk of scarring to a minimum, and the wounds fade naturally within a few months.
5. Results Do Not Last a Lifetime
Although double eyelid surgery gives long-term results, age and gravity continue to affect the eyelid crease over time.

As we age, the skin starts to sag, the crease may become shallower, or more fat may accumulate in the eyelid, and the shape can change. To help the result last longer, care for the skin around your eyes, get enough sleep and avoid rubbing your eyes hard. Doing these consistently together helps extend the life of the result.
6. What to Know Before Deciding on Double Eyelid Surgery
For the best and safest result, you should prepare and learn the following.

items.x: Choose a reliable facility: check that the clinic or hospital is licensed by the Ministry of Public Health, that the doctors hold professional licenses and that there are reviews from real patients.

Consult the doctor thoroughly: the consultation before surgery matters a great deal, since the doctor examines your eyes and the balance between the two sides and explains the suitable surgical method.
Stop certain medications and supplements before surgery, such as aspirin, vitamin E and fish oil, since they may increase bruising or bleeding.
Plan your recovery: although you do not need to stay in the hospital, you should set aside at least 3 to 7 days to rest and avoid strenuous exercise at first, as well as rubbing your eyes.

blocks.x: 7. Aftercare for a Good Result
After double eyelid surgery, caring for yourself matters, since good and appropriate care helps the wounds heal faster and gives a good result. After surgery you should:

items.x: Apply cold compresses during the first 48 hours to reduce swelling
Avoid rubbing your eyes and clean gently with gauze
Sleep with your head raised to help blood circulate well
Avoid alcohol and cigarettes for at least 2 weeks
Return to the doctor for follow-up as scheduled

blocks.x: Double eyelid surgery is a matter of beauty and also a way of caring for yourself on your own terms. If you are looking for a way to strengthen your personality, open yourself to new opportunities or make your eyes look brighter and more confident, double eyelid surgery may be the right answer for you.

Remember that real beauty begins with understanding yourself and choosing the best for our body and mind. When you are ready for a change, the specialist surgical team at Apex Surgery Hospital is ready to look after you closely at every step, so that the result is "more beautiful eyes" and also "a more confident version of you."

A brow lift corrects sagging skin on the forehead and brows, which comes from skin changes with age, sun exposure, pollution and a lack of proper skin care. These make the skin deteriorate faster and eventually lead to wrinkles and deep lines on the face.

Types of Brow Lift
Brow lift surgery has been developed into many techniques to address the problems that come from sagging around the brows. They are:

items.x: Direct Brow Lifting: brow lift surgery with an incision at the upper edge of the brow. The excess skin above the brow is cut away and the brow is sutured up to a suitable position. It can be done only at the tail of the brow or along the full length from the head to the tail. The advantages are a short operating time and a short recovery.

Pretrichial Brow Lift: a brow lift method that was popular in the past. The doctor makes an incision along the length of the forehead above the brows. The advantage is that it tightens the facial skin, and it suits people with a lot of facial skin sagging.

Coronal Brow Lift: another traditional brow lift method, with an incision running from one ear to the other across the scalp. It can lift the brows a great deal but leaves a large surgical scar. It is less popular today because newer brow lift techniques leave smaller scars.

Temporal Brow Lift: a brow lift of the brow tail only, which suits people whose brow tails droop while the rest of the brow stays in a good position. The incisions are small and hidden in the hairline.

Sub-Brow Lift: surgery that lifts the outer eye corner with the incision hidden under the brow. It suits people with drooping outer eye corners or who want a sharper look to the eyes, and the incision hides well.

Endotine Brow Lift: brow lift surgery using an endoscope and special brow-lifting devices. The incisions are small and recovery is quick. It suits people with drooping brows or who want to correct wrinkles on the face.

blocks.x: What Is Endotine?
Endotine is a small medical device shaped like a triangular pin, made from natural-grade material. It dissolves by itself about 6 to 12 months after surgery, depending on the individual.

items.x: Small incisions: this brow lift technique is performed through an endoscope, so the incisions are small and recovery is quick.

Durability: the result is more durable than traditional methods.
Safety: the Endotine pin used in the brow lift dissolves by itself, so it is safer.

Mildly drooping eyelids

Planning the Brow Lift

items.x: Consultation: in the first step you talk with the surgeon so the doctor knows your problem, goals and expectations.
Skin assessment: the doctor checks the skin's elasticity, the thickness of the skin and the bone structure.
Photography: photos of the face are taken from several angles to plan the brow lift.
Result simulation: the surgeon simulates the expected result so the patient can see how it will look after surgery.
Choosing the Endotine position: the doctor determines the suitable positions for placing Endotine to get the best result.

blocks.x: Preparing for the Brow Lift

items.x: Health check: blood tests and a heart function test may be needed to confirm that the body is ready for brow lift surgery.
Stop certain medications: stop anti-inflammatory drugs, blood thinners and certain supplements 2 weeks before the brow lift.
Stop smoking: stop smoking for at least 2 to 4 weeks before and after the brow lift.

Arrange a caregiver: arrange for someone to take you home and care for you during the first 24 to 48 hours after the brow lift.

blocks.x: The Brow Lift Procedure

Incisions: the doctor makes small incisions at the temples or in the hair (about 3 to 5 incisions of 1 to 2 cm).
Inserting the endoscope: a small camera (endoscope) is inserted to view the area of the brow lift.
Lifting the tissue: the doctor lifts the tissue under the skin and the muscle to the position the doctor has planned.
Placing Endotine: Endotine is inserted under the lifted tissue to hold the tissue in the new position.
Closing the incisions: the incisions are closed with dissolvable sutures or small clips.

blocks.x: The Endotine brow lift takes the doctor about 1 to 2 hours, depending on the complexity of the surgery.

blocks.x: Aftercare for the Brow Lift

Apply cold compresses to reduce swelling: use ice packs to reduce swelling during the first 48 hours.

blocks.x: Everyone wants a youthful face, since it builds confidence and also opens up many opportunities in life. The facelift is one of the methods gaining popularity today. Many procedures can lift and tighten the face and correct wrinkles, but they give only temporary results. For people who want longer-lasting results, facelift surgery has become an attractive option.

Choosing a facelift is an important decision that needs careful consideration, since the surgery requires both the surgeon's expertise in facelifts and good skin care after surgery. This article explains the facelift in more depth through these frequently asked questions.
1. What Is a Facelift?
Answer: a facelift is a surgical procedure that lifts and repositions the skin and the tissue beneath the skin on the face and neck to correct sagging and wrinkles, so the face looks younger.
2. Who Is a Facelift Suitable For?
Answer: people who have clear sagging and wrinkles on the face and neck and are reasonably healthy. A consultation with a doctor will tell you whether a facelift suits you.
3. How Many Types of Facelift Are There?
Answer: there are several types of facelift, which differ by technique and the level of correction needed. The main types are:

items.x: Traditional Facelift: surgery that covers the whole face and neck. The surgeon lifts and repositions the skin and the tissue beneath the skin to correct sagging and wrinkles. It suits people with clear sagging and wrinkles across the whole face and neck. The result lasts longer, and recovery is also longer.

Mini Facelift: surgery that corrects only part of the face, such as the cheeks and jaw, using a smaller operation and a faster recovery. It suits people with mild to moderate sagging in specific areas. The result lasts about 1 to 3 years, shorter than a traditional facelift, and recovery is shorter.

Mid-Facelift: focuses on correcting the middle of the face, such as the cheeks and under the eyes, without involving the lower face and neck. It suits people whose sagging and wrinkles are only in the middle of the face. Recovery is faster and the operation is smaller.

SMAS Facelift: surgery that lifts and repositions the muscle layer under the skin called the SMAS (Superficial Musculoaponeurotic System) for a lasting result. It suits people who want a long-lasting result. This surgery is more complex and recovery is longer.

Deep Plane Facelift: facelift surgery to correct sagging facial skin in which an experienced surgeon goes deep into the tissue beneath the SMAS muscle layer and releases the SMAS layer. This lets the surgeon lift and tighten the muscle and skin of the face more easily, so the result does not look abnormal or pulled tight and lasts longer.

blocks.x: 4. What Are the Risks of a Facelift?
Answer: a facelift is a surgery whose possible risks need attention. In general, before surgery the surgeon explains the various risks, which include:

items.x: Infection after facelift surgery
Scars that may be visible
A collection of blood under the skin (hematoma) after a facelift
Numbness in the area of the facelift
Swelling that may last longer than usual
Risks from general anesthesia
Fibrous scar tissue under the skin
Facial asymmetry

blocks.x: To reduce these risks, choose a surgeon who specializes in facelifts and follow the self-care instructions strictly.
5. How Long Does a Facelift Take?
Answer: it depends on the type of facelift. A traditional facelift may take 2 to 4 hours, while a mini facelift or a thread lift may take less.
6. How Long Is the Recovery?

Answer: recovery depends on the type of facelift. A traditional facelift may take several weeks to several months, while a mini facelift or a thread lift may need only a few days to two weeks of recovery.
7. How Long Do Facelift Results Last?
Answer: the results of a traditional facelift and a SMAS facelift can last more than 5 years, depending on care. With regular care and maintenance, they may last as long as 10 years.
8. About How Much Does a Facelift Cost?

Answer: the cost depends on the type of facelift and the facility. A traditional facelift and a SMAS facelift may cost more than a mini facelift. The doctor examines the structure of the face, the muscles and the skin before recommending which facelift method to use for a lifted face, so to know the exact cost of facelift surgery, consult a doctor first.
9. Will There Be a Scar After a Facelift?

Answer: in general, facelift surgery leaves visible incisions, but the surgeon tries to hide the scars in places that cannot be seen. Whether a scar remains depends on many factors. Scars may be hidden in the hair and behind the ears. In some cases a keloid scar may form. After a facelift, take good care of the incisions, which helps reduce the risk of scarring.
10. How Should I Prepare Before a Facelift?

Answer: preparation before a facelift is important and should not be neglected. Discuss the preparation clearly with your doctor. In most cases the surgeon gives the following guidance before surgery:

items.x: Have a thorough health check. The important tests are blood tests, a chest X-ray and an electrocardiogram
Stop smoking at least 2 to 4 weeks before the facelift
Stop drinking alcohol for at least 2 weeks
Tell the doctor about drug allergies
Stop medications that affect blood clotting

blocks.x: The patient should also understand the facelift process, prepare mentally for the changes that will occur and plan the recovery period in advance so that recovery goes smoothly.
11. Will I See the Results Right After Facelift Surgery?

Answer: in general you see a change immediately after surgery, but the final result is clearly visible after the swelling and bruising are gone, which may take several weeks to several months, depending on each person's body.
12. How Should I Care for Myself After a Facelift?
Answer: self-care after a facelift matters for a good and lasting result. After facelift surgery:
Wound care

items.x: Clean the incisions as the doctor recommends
Avoid touching the incisions directly
Watch for abnormal symptoms in the body and at the incisions

blocks.x: Recovery

items.x: Get enough rest
Avoid strenuous exercise
Eat nutritious food
Drink enough water
Always use sunscreen
Wear a hat or use an umbrella in the sun and avoid long periods in strong sunlight

blocks.x: 13. What Precautions Apply After a Facelift?
Answer: besides good self-care, after facelift surgery you should avoid things that could raise the risk of complications at the incisions. They are:

items.x: Avoid smoking for at least 4 to 6 weeks
Avoid alcohol
Avoid cosmetics at first
Protect the surgical area from bumps and impact
Take medication strictly as the doctor prescribes

blocks.x: 14. If I Am Not Ready for a Facelift, How Can I Care for My Facial Skin to Slow Sagging?
Answer: if you are not ready for a facelift, whether for financial or health reasons, you can start by caring for your facial skin yourself in the following ways:

items.x: Cleanse your facial skin correctly
Use a moisturizer that suits your skin condition
Use sunscreen every day
Eat nutritious food and drink enough water
Get enough rest
Avoid behaviors that harm the skin

blocks.x: 15. How Many Days After Facelift Surgery Does the Swelling Go Down?
Answer: in general, swelling starts to decrease after weeks 2 to 3 following a facelift. Patients can reduce the swelling by applying cold compresses regularly.
16. How Should I Care for My Facial Skin to Make Facelift Results Last Longer?
Answer: to make facelift results last longer, care for your facial skin regularly in the following ways:

items.x: Use skincare products as the doctor recommends
Avoid harsh scrubbing or exfoliating of the skin
Apply sunscreen regularly, and wear a hat or use an umbrella whenever you are outdoors
Eat nutritious food
Exercise regularly
Avoid stress
Avoid smoking and alcoholic drinks
Attend appointments with the doctor regularly and consult the doctor whenever you have questions

blocks.x: A facelift is an important decision that needs careful consideration. Anyone interested should gather complete information, consult an experienced doctor and prepare both body and mind, to get the best result from a facelift.

blocks.x: In an age when keeping the face youthful matters, the forehead lift has become a popular choice for people who want to reduce wrinkles and lines on the face, particularly in the forehead and brow area. A forehead lift, known medically as a Forehead lift, is a surgical method that lifts and tightens the skin of the forehead and brows, making the face look more youthful and refreshed.
Why Have a Forehead Lift?

The forehead lift is a method that is becoming ever more popular in cosmetic surgery, but many people may wonder why a forehead lift is needed. The following are the main reasons people choose to have one.

items.x: Corrects drooping brows: With age, the skin and muscles of the forehead tend to sag, causing the brows to drop and the face to look tired. A forehead lift raises the brows to a suitable position, making the eyes look brighter and more alert.
Reduces forehead wrinkles: Horizontal forehead lines are among the first signs of aging. A forehead lift reduces these wrinkles effectively, making the skin look smoother and younger.

Corrects wrinkles between the brows: Vertical lines between the brows, known as frown lines, often make the face look stern or angry. A forehead lift reduces these lines, making the face look more relaxed and friendly.
Adds balance to the face: A forehead lift improves the forehead area and also creates balance across the whole face, especially when combined with surgery on other areas of the face.
Corrects drooping eyelids: In some cases, a forehead lift can help correct drooping eyelids by raising the brows, which reduces pressure on the eyelids and makes the eyes look more open and bright.

Builds confidence: A youthful, fresh-looking face can build confidence for many people, especially in a society that places importance on outward appearance, and a forehead lift can help build that confidence.
Corrects medical problems: In some cases, a forehead lift may be part of medical treatment, such as correcting vision problems caused by drooping brows or eyelids.

Longer-lasting results: Compared with other non-surgical methods such as Botox injections, a forehead lift gives much longer-lasting results, which may be better value for some people in the long run.
Reshapes the brows: Besides lifting the brows, a forehead lift can shape the brows as desired, which can change the character of the face considerably.
Slows the appearance of wrinkles: Although a forehead lift cannot stop the aging process, it can effectively slow the appearance of signs of aging on the face.

blocks.x: Types of Forehead Lift

There are several forehead lift methods and techniques, each with its own advantages and limitations. Choosing the right method depends on the patient's skin condition, needs, and the surgeon's advice. The main types of forehead lift are as follows:
Open Forehead Lift (Open Brow Lift)

items.x: Method: The forehead lift is performed through a long incision along or above the hairline.
Advantages: Gives clear results and can correct problems comprehensively.
Disadvantages: Longer scar and a longer recovery time.
Suitable for: People with significant drooping of the forehead and brows.

blocks.x: Endoscopic Forehead Lift (Endoscopic Brow Lift)

items.x: Method: Uses an endoscope and small instruments through small incisions on the scalp.
Advantages: Small incisions, quick recovery, and minimal scarring.
Disadvantages: May not suit people with severe problems.
Suitable for: People with mild to moderate problems who want quick recovery.

blocks.x: Temporal Brow Lift

items.x: Method: Surgery is performed through small incisions at the temples.
Advantages: Small incisions, suitable for lifting the outer brow.
Disadvantages: Cannot correct problems in the middle of the forehead very much.
Suitable for: People who want to lift the outer brow specifically.

blocks.x: Hairline Brow Lift

items.x: Method: The forehead lift is performed through an incision along the front hairline.
Advantages: Can also reduce the height of the forehead.
Disadvantages: May leave a visible scar.
Suitable for: People with a high forehead who want to reduce its height while lifting the brows.

blocks.x: Direct Brow Lift

items.x: Method: The forehead lift is performed directly above the brow.
Advantages: Gives precise, well-controlled results.
Disadvantages: Leaves a clearly visible scar.
Suitable for: Men with thinning hair or baldness, or people with very deep wrinkles.

blocks.x: Coronal Brow Lift

items.x: Method: The forehead lift is performed through a long incision from one ear to the other along the hairline.
Advantages: Can correct problems across the entire forehead.
Disadvantages: Long scar, and hair may thin along the incision.
Suitable for: People with severe problems who want clear results.

blocks.x: Who Is Suited to a Forehead Lift?
The forehead lift is a popular cosmetic surgery and suits the following groups of people:

items.x: People aged 40 to 65: People in this age range generally begin to have more noticeable sagging skin and wrinkles, which makes it a suitable time for a forehead lift.

People with sagging skin in the forehead and brow area: People with drooping brows or sagging forehead skin that makes the face look tired or older than their age. A forehead lift may be a suitable option.
People with deep forehead wrinkles: If you have deep, clear horizontal wrinkles on the forehead, a forehead lift can help reduce them.
Healthy people: Any surgery requires a healthy body for good recovery, so people in good overall health are suited to a forehead lift.
People with reasonable expectations: People who understand the limits and possible results of a forehead lift and have reasonable expectations are generally suited to the surgery.
Non-smokers: Not smoking, or being able to quit for a period before and after surgery, helps recovery and lowers the risk of complications.

blocks.x: Who Is Not Suited to a Forehead Lift?
Although the forehead lift is a safe surgery today, it may not suit some people, since it could do more harm than good. They include:

items.x: People with serious underlying conditions: People with heart disease, uncontrolled high blood pressure, uncontrolled diabetes, or other conditions that may raise the risk of forehead lift surgery are not suited to this surgery.
People with clotting problems: People whose blood does not clot properly or who take blood thinners may be at too high a risk for forehead lift surgery.
People who are significantly overweight: Severe obesity may raise the risk of forehead lift surgery and affect recovery, so it may not be suitable.

Smokers who cannot quit: Smoking harms wound healing and raises the risk of complications. People who cannot quit smoking are not suited to forehead lift surgery, since it can slow wound healing or cause complications.
People with unreasonable expectations: Those with exaggerated expectations, or expectations that do not match what a forehead lift can do, may not be suited to forehead lift surgery.

People with mental health conditions: People with untreated or uncontrolled mental health conditions, such as severe depression or Body Dysmorphic Disorder (obsessive preoccupation with appearance), may not be suited to forehead lift surgery.

People with keloid scars: People with a history of keloid scars (scar tissue that grows beyond the boundary of the original wound) may not be suited to forehead lift surgery, since there is a high risk of unattractive scarring.
People who are too young: Generally, people under 30 may not yet need a forehead lift, since their skin is still elastic and there are more suitable ways to care for the skin.

blocks.x: How Should You Choose a Forehead Lift?
The choice of forehead lift type should consider the following factors:

items.x: The patient's skin condition and facial structure
The severity of the problem
The desired result
The acceptable recovery time
Concerns about scarring
The surgeon's experience and expertise

blocks.x: An expert surgeon will assess and recommend the most suitable method for each person, and sometimes techniques may be combined to get the best possible result. Technology also keeps producing new methods, so it is important to consult a surgeon with up-to-date knowledge.
What Is Endotine?

Endotine is a medical device used in the endoscopic forehead lift (Endoscopic Forehead lift), the latest innovation in lifting and tightening the forehead and brows. Endotine is made of a material that dissolves in the body, helping the forehead lift to be precise and give a more natural result.
Advantages of the Endotine Forehead Lift

items.x: Small forehead lift incisions: The Endotine forehead lift uses an endoscopic surgical technique, leaving only 3 to 5 small incisions on the scalp, which are easily hidden under the hair.
Quick recovery: Since no large incision is made, patients recover faster than with traditional surgery.
Natural results: Endotine allows the surgeon to adjust the height of the brow precisely, producing a more natural-looking result.
Lower risk of scalp numbness: The nerves of the forehead do not need to be cut as in traditional surgery.
Suitable for people with a high forehead: The Endotine forehead lift does not make the forehead higher as traditional surgery does, so it suits people who already have a high forehead.

blocks.x: Endotine Forehead Lift Procedure

items.x: Consultation: Before forehead lift surgery, the patient consults the surgeon, who assesses the skin condition and facial structure, as well as suitability for surgery.

Preparing before forehead lift surgery: The patient is given advice on preparation, such as not smoking, stopping certain medications, and fasting from food and water before the forehead lift surgery.
Anesthesia: The Endotine forehead lift can be done under general anesthesia or local anesthesia, at the doctor's discretion.
Forehead lift procedure: The surgeon makes 3 to 5 small incisions on the scalp, then uses an endoscope and special instruments to lift the skin and muscle of the forehead and brows.
Placing the Endotine: After lifting the skin and muscle, the surgeon places the Endotine to hold the tissue in its new position.
Closing the incisions: The incisions are closed with fine sutures.
Recovery after the forehead lift: The patient is given instructions on caring for the forehead lift incisions and on how to behave after the surgery.

blocks.x: Self-Care After a Forehead Lift

items.x: Rest enough: Sleep with your head raised on pillows to reduce swelling.
Cold compresses: Apply an ice pack to reduce swelling and bruising.
Avoid strenuous activity: Avoid heavy exercise for at least 2 to 3 weeks.
Incision care: Clean and change dressings as the doctor advises.
Avoid sunlight: Use sunscreen and wear a hat when going outdoors.

blocks.x: Results of a Forehead Lift
The Endotine forehead lift can help with the following problems:

items.x: Reduces forehead wrinkles: A forehead lift can effectively reduce wrinkles and lines.
Lifts the brows to an attractive position: Forehead lift surgery can correct drooping brows, making the eyes look brighter and more lifted.
Reduces wrinkles between the brows: Forehead lift surgery helps reduce wrinkles caused by frowning, making the face look more relaxed.
Makes the face look younger: Lifting and tightening the skin of the forehead and brows makes the whole face look younger.

blocks.x: Considerations Before a Forehead Lift
Although the Endotine forehead lift is an effective way to reduce wrinkles and lift the face, there are the following considerations:

items.x: Suitability of the patient: A forehead lift does not suit everyone. Consult a doctor to assess suitability.
Reasonable expectations: Patients should have reasonable expectations about the results they will get.
Cost: A forehead lift is an expensive surgery, so consider its value and your own budget.
Recovery time: Although Endotine helps shorten recovery, some recovery time is still needed.
Risks and complications: As with all surgery, a forehead lift carries risks and may cause complications. Discuss this thoroughly with the doctor.

blocks.x: Alternatives to a Forehead Lift
For people who are not ready for or do not want surgery, there are other ways to reduce wrinkles and lift the face, such as:

items.x: Botox injections: Effectively reduce forehead wrinkles and lines between the brows, but the results do not last as long as surgery.
Filler injections: Fill deep lines and add volume to the face, making it look younger.
Laser treatment: Stimulates collagen and elastin production in the skin, making the skin look firmer and smoother.
Skincare creams: Creams containing retinoids or vitamin C can help reduce wrinkles and improve skin condition.
Skin-tightening treatments: Tighten the skin and reduce wrinkles without surgery.

blocks.x: However, these methods may give less obvious results or may not last as long as a surgical forehead lift.
Can Younger People Have a Forehead Lift?

A forehead lift is often seen as a procedure for older people with obvious wrinkles, but in reality age is not the only factor that decides who should or should not have one. The following are points to consider for younger people who are interested in a forehead lift:

items.x: Skin condition and facial structure: Even when young, some people have genetic traits that cause drooping brows or forehead wrinkles at an early age. In this case, a forehead lift may be a suitable option.
Prevention rather than correction: Some people choose a forehead lift at a young age to prevent future wrinkles. However, most doctors advise starting with non-invasive methods first.
Medical suitability: In some cases, such as people with vision problems due to drooping brows or eyelids, a forehead lift may be a suitable option even at a young age.

blocks.x: Skincare to Slow Wrinkles
Besides a forehead lift, regular skincare is important for slowing wrinkles and lines. The following is skincare advice:

items.x: Cleanse regularly: Wash your face with a gentle product suited to your skin.
Use sunscreen: Protect the skin from UV rays, the main cause of premature wrinkles.
Moisturize: Use a skincare cream containing moisturizing ingredients such as hyaluronic acid.
Eat healthily: Eat food rich in the vitamins and minerals needed for skin health.
Drink enough water: Water keeps skin hydrated from the inside out.
Get enough rest: Enough sleep lets the skin renew itself.
Reduce stress: Stress can speed up the aging process.
Exercise regularly: Exercise stimulates blood circulation, making the skin look fresh.

post:liposuction-facts.title: What You May Not Know About Liposuction
post:liposuction-facts.author: oraya choeipho

blocks.x: In an era when people care more about their figure and health, a toned body has become a goal many people want, whether they exercise regularly or try to control their weight. Some areas are still “hard to slim”, such as belly fat, upper arms, thighs, or the fat under the chin. Liposuction is one of the medical procedures that meets the need for “spot fat reduction” quickly and precisely.

Although it is a popular procedure, many people still misunderstand liposuction or do not know the important information they should know before deciding. Today we will help you understand more with “What You May Not Know About Liposuction”, so you can decide with confidence and safety.
1. Liposuction Is Not a Weight-Loss Method

Many people may mistakenly believe that liposuction will reduce weight quickly, but in reality liposuction does not reduce weight significantly. Fat is light, so after a certain amount is removed, weight may drop by only 1 to 3 kilograms.

What liposuction can do is “reshape the body” so that proportions look better, such as reducing a belly, reducing upper arms, creating an S-line waist, and so on. It suits people whose weight is already stable but who want to remove stubborn fat deposits in specific areas, such as the lower abdomen, inner thighs, or lower back.
2. More Modern Liposuction Technologies Are Available
Today there are several liposuction techniques, each with different advantages, such as:

items.x: Body Jet Liposuction: uses water pressure to separate fat from the tissue, reducing bruising of the blood vessels and surrounding tissue. Suitable for people who want to recover quickly.

VASER Liposuction: a liposuction technology that uses ultrasound waves to break down fat before removing it, so the fat that is removed stays in good condition. Suitable for transferring the fat to other areas.
Laser Liposuction (SmartLipo): uses a laser to melt fat before removing it, while also tightening the skin and reducing skin waviness.

blocks.x: However, choosing the right liposuction method should be done under the guidance of an experienced doctor, since the skin condition, the thickness of the fat, and the purpose of the procedure must all be assessed, so that the result is realistic and as close as possible to what the patient wants.
3. Liposuction Does Not Hurt and Needs No Long Recovery

With today's medical advances, liposuction can be done under local anesthesia or general anesthesia. These medications keep the patient from feeling pain during the procedure, and swelling or soreness afterward is much lower.

In some cases, patients can go home the same day and need only a few days of recovery (depending on the amount and location of the fat removed). Generally, a compression garment may be needed for about 2 to 4 weeks, and strenuous exercise should be avoided at first.
4. Liposuction Can Support Good Health
Although the main goal of liposuction is aesthetic, in some cases it also affects health, for example:

items.x: Contributes to lowering triglycerides and unhealthy fats in the blood
Helps some patients with fat deposits around the liver or pancreas to have better health
Helps reduce pressure on the knee or hip joints in people with a lot of fat in the lower body

blocks.x: However, liposuction should be used as a supplementary option rather than as the main treatment for any disease.
5. The Results Are Not Equivalent to Exercise

There is a misconception that whole-body liposuction gives results equal to only 1 month of exercise, but in reality liposuction and exercise give different results. Liposuction only removes excess fat and does not build muscle or increase the body's strength the way exercise does.
6. It Must Be Done Under a Qualified Doctor

Liposuction is a medical procedure that should be performed by a qualified doctor in a facility licensed to perform cosmetic surgery. It should not be done at an illegal clinic or an unlicensed facility, because complications may occur, such as infection, heavy blood loss, uneven skin, or, in severe cases, death.

Before deciding on liposuction, check that the doctor is a plastic surgeon certified by the Medical Council of Thailand and has experience specifically with this procedure, to be confident in both safety and a satisfactory result.
7. Results Are Not Permanent Without Continued Self-Care
Although liposuction can permanently remove some fat cells, if you do not control your diet or lack exercise, the body can build up new fat again in the areas that were previously treated.

Therefore, looking after yourself after the procedure, such as eating suitably, exercising regularly, and resting enough, will help the results last longer and keep fat from returning to the same area.

Liposuction is an interesting option for people who want to remove excess fat but have limits in reducing their proportions, such as being unable to control their diet or exercise regularly. However, the decision to have liposuction should weigh the pros and cons carefully, since liposuction is a type of surgery that carries risks, including results that may not match what was wanted and other side effects. You should also consult a surgeon experienced in liposuction to be confident that it will give a satisfactory result, and that the patient receives the highest level of safety throughout the surgery.

They suit teardrop-shaped implants, since they prevent the implant from rotating or shifting, and they reduce the risk of capsular contracture better than smooth surfaces. The drawbacks are that the breast may show ripples and the feel is less smooth than a smooth surface. There have also been reports linking some textured implant models to ALCL, a type of lymphoma. Although this is very rare, it is worth considering.

3. Nano or Micro-textured Surface (Nano / Micro-textured Surface): An innovation that combines the advantages of smooth and textured surfaces. These implants give a soft feel close to a smooth surface while reducing the chance of capsular contracture as well as a textured surface does. post:nose-surgery-without-silicone.title: Silicone-Free Rhinoplasty: How Is It Better Than Conventional Rhinoplasty?
post:nose-surgery-without-silicone.author: oraya choeipho

blocks.x: Nose surgery trends are always changing, especially the materials used to augment the nose, which have developed from silicone to today's use of the body's own cartilage. Using the patient's own material has become more popular because it carries a lower risk of the body rejecting it than synthetic materials. Although the price is higher than traditional rhinoplasty, many people are ready to invest for beauty and long-term satisfaction. This article presents the advantages of silicone-free rhinoplasty with the body's own materials so that anyone interested in or planning a rhinoplasty can compare before deciding.
Advantages of Silicone-Free Rhinoplasty

Silicone-free rhinoplasty today uses the open rhinoplasty method (Open Rhinoplasty) and mostly uses material from the patient's own body. In some cases artificial tissue is also used together with it. Overall, silicone-free rhinoplasty has the following advantages:

items.x: Lower risk of the body rejecting the implant

blocks.x: Silicone-free rhinoplasty means augmenting the nose with natural material. Today the commonly used material is the patient's own cartilage, namely cartilage from behind the ear and also rib cartilage. Since these materials come from the body of the person having the rhinoplasty, the risk of rejection is lower, especially for people who are allergic to silicone-based materials. Doctors often recommend this approach as a first option as well.

items.x: Nose structure can be adjusted to match what you want more closely

blocks.x: In silicone-free rhinoplasty the surgeon uses the open approach, Open Rhinoplasty, which requires an incision under the base of the nose to expose the whole nasal structure. This gives the surgeon more room to work and lets the shape be adjusted as desired, producing a result that suits each person's face better.

items.x: A result closer to a natural nose

blocks.x: Using the patient's own cartilage instead of silicone has another interesting advantage: the newly augmented nose looks like a natural nose. It suits people who want a nose that does not rise abnormally, that resembles a natural nose, or that cannot be told to have been operated on.

items.x: Durability and Longevity: Silicone-free rhinoplasty is more durable and long-lasting, since it uses the patient's own cartilage, which avoids the problems of the material shifting or wearing away that come with silicone, and it can heal into the natural nasal structure over time.

Suitable for Correcting Complex Nose Problems: The Open Rhinoplasty technique used in silicone-free rhinoplasty can correct complex nose problems better, such as cases where a previous augmentation led to perforation of the nose, or where an abnormal nasal structure needs correcting, including people with thin nasal tissue.

Lower Risk of Long-Term Side Effects: Although silicone-free rhinoplasty may take longer to perform and may have a slightly longer recovery period, compared with conventional rhinoplasty it may have fewer long-term side effects, since no foreign material is placed in the body.

Suitable for People Allergic to Silicone: For people with a history of allergy to silicone or other synthetic materials, silicone-free rhinoplasty is a more suitable choice, since it uses the patient's own cartilage.

blocks.x: Clip On Rhinoplasty: An Additional Method for a Projected, Prominent Nose

Besides silicone-free rhinoplasty, to give the nose a strong structure and make it look projected without looking fake like conventional rhinoplasty, Dr. Somboon Waiphrip has researched and developed an additional method that places rib cartilage under the tip of the nose. This method makes the nose more projected while still looking like a natural nose, helps hold the newly augmented nasal structure more firmly, and also reduces the risk of perforation.
Who Is Suited to Silicone-Free Rhinoplasty?
Silicone-free rhinoplasty augments the nose with the patient's own material, such as cartilage from behind the ear or rib cartilage. It suits people with the following characteristics or needs:

items.x: People who want to reduce the risk of side effects: Using your own material reduces the risk of foreign-body rejection or chronic inflammation, so it is very suitable for people who are allergic to silicone or synthetic materials, who have a history of infection after silicone rhinoplasty, or who are worried about the long-term effects of silicone rhinoplasty.

People who have had a rhinoplasty before and developed problems such as a crooked, perforated, or deformed silicone implant: Silicone-free augmentation, which requires the open approach, helps the doctor correct the nasal structure to look better using the patient's own material, and reduces the risk of the same problem recurring.

People who want the most natural nose shape: A nose augmented with cartilage or the body's own tissue is not a rigid rod like silicone, so the shape looks soft, does not look fake, and suits the face well in the long term.
People who plan to have surgery only once: Rhinoplasty with your own material usually costs more but gives permanent results in many cases and reduces the need to return for repeated revisions.

People with thin nasal tissue or a short nose: People with a small nasal base or a very thin nasal tip face a high risk of perforation with silicone, so using their own cartilage is the more suitable choice.

blocks.x: Silicone-free rhinoplasty is an aesthetic option that also reduces the chance of long-term complications, by using the body's own material, which tends to respond to the body better than synthetic materials.
If you are looking for a rhinoplasty method that addresses appearance, fit with your face, and long-term self-care, silicone-free rhinoplasty may be a suitable option for you.

Q: What are the risks of rhinoplasty?

A: In most cases, if the rhinoplasty is done at a clinic that meets standards and is certified by the Ministry of Public Health, the risk of dangerous complications is lower. Other risks may still occur, such as:

items.x: A crooked or uneven nose
Scarring, or thin skin in some areas of the nose
Infection, or perforation of the nose when unsuitable implant material is used
Scar tissue formation that causes the nose to contract

blocks.x: Q: Can a nose that has already been done be corrected?

A: Yes, but the original nose must heal fully first. Doctors generally advise waiting at least 6 months to 1 year before a revision, and a revision should be done by a specialist doctor with experience in this area, to prevent chronic problems in the future.
Q: Which type of rhinoplasty is best?
A: There is no fixed answer to “best”, since it depends on each person's face shape and needs. Examples of popular techniques are:

items.x: Open Rhinoplasty: the incision is made under the base of the nose, suitable for detailed correction of the nasal structure
Closed Rhinoplasty: the incision is inside the nose and small, suitable for cases that need little adjustment
Silicone augmentation: very popular because it is easy to shape, but only medical-grade silicone should be used
Using your own cartilage (Autologous Graft): such as ear cartilage or rib cartilage, for people with very thin skin or who want a high degree of naturalness

blocks.x: Q: How should I prepare before rhinoplasty?
A: Before rhinoplasty surgery, patients need to prepare as follows:

items.x: Avoid certain supplements, such as vitamin E and fish oil
Tell the doctor about any underlying conditions or drug allergies
Do not smoke for 2 weeks before and after surgery, since smoking affects wound healing
Wash your face clean on the day of surgery and avoid makeup and skincare creams

blocks.x: Q: About how much does rhinoplasty cost?
A: In most cases the price of rhinoplasty depends on the surgical method, the doctor's reputation, the material used to augment the nose, and other costs. The approximate prices are:

items.x: Standard technique: 15,000 to 30,000 baht
Open technique / revision rhinoplasty: 40,000 to 100,000 baht and up
Using your own cartilage: 150,000 baht and up

blocks.x: Q: How should I choose a rhinoplasty clinic?

A: If you want results that match your needs with low risk, choose a licensed clinic where the surgery is performed by a surgeon with a specialist board certificate in plastic surgery, with trained nurses and staff, a clean facility that meets standards, ready medical equipment, reviews from past patients, or Before-After cases that can be verified.
Q: How should I take care of myself after rhinoplasty?
A: Self-care after rhinoplasty is important for getting the results you expect and for reducing the risk of other undesirable symptoms. After surgery, take care of yourself as follows:

items.x: Avoid very salty or very spicy food at first
Do not remove the plaster or the nasal splint yourself; wait for the doctor to remove it
Avoid bending your head down or sleeping on your side
Take the antibiotics and anti-swelling medication prescribed by the doctor strictly as directed

blocks.x: Rhinoplasty relates to confidence and long-term health as well as appearance. Researching thoroughly, choosing a doctor you trust, and caring for yourself correctly are all important factors in getting the beautiful result you intend.

blocks.x: A facelift is a surgical procedure that lifts and tightens the muscles and muscular structure of the face, including the various ligaments, to correct sagging skin or to adjust the facial structure so it looks more symmetrical and more youthful. Facelift techniques are now more varied than before, but the most popular is the facelift that lifts and tightens the SMAS muscle layer, the layer that is important in facelift surgery and in every kind of skin lifting, because when the SMAS layer is lifted or tightened, the whole face looks smoother and more naturally youthful.
What Is SMAS?

SMAS (Superficial Musculo Aponeurotic System) is the muscle layer beneath the fat layer of the skin. This muscle layer is very important to facelift surgery and to procedures that lift and tighten the face, because the SMAS layer is connected to the skin and the subcutaneous fat above it, so lifting or surgically pulling the muscle in this area can tighten the skin of the entire face. However, if a SMAS facelift is performed without expertise or in the wrong way, the facial muscles can be pulled too tight and look unnatural.
(Insert image: SMAS muscle layer)
What Types of Facelift Are There?
Facelift surgery has developed considerably, so correcting wrinkles and sagging of the face and neck is no longer an unrealistic goal. The popular types of facelift are as follows:
Endoscopic Pin-Fixation Brow Lift (Endotine Brow Lift)

The Endoscopic Pin-Fixation Brow Lift (Endotine Brow Lift) is a new brow lift technique that is more effective than the traditional brow lift. It must be performed by an experienced specialist aesthetic plastic surgeon, since the incisions are very small and hidden in places that are barely noticeable, so it takes enough precision and expertise to get a satisfying result.
Facelift (Face Lift)

The DFL Deep Plane Facelift is a newer, more advanced facelift technique in which the doctor goes deeper than the SMAS to release the ligaments beneath the SMAS layer. As a result, the doctor can lift the muscle and skin further, so the face looks lifted without looking pulled tight, looks natural, and the result lasts longer.
Neck Lift

Neck lift surgery at Apex Surgery Hospital uses the same technique as the DFL Deep Plane Facelift, which releases the ligaments beneath the SMAS muscle layer so the surgeon can lift the muscle further. The result looks smooth and natural.

Apex Surgery Hospital offers facelift surgery in all the areas mentioned, and also helps adjust the face shape to look softer or more balanced. As a result, besides smoother skin, a facelift at Apex Surgery Hospital can make you look up to 20 years younger.
Checklist: Is It Time for a Facelift?

Pollution and modern lifestyles speed up the body's deterioration faster than it should. In the past, signs of deterioration appeared as people grew older, but today sagging of the facial and neck skin appears sooner than before. When sagging of the face and neck is affecting your confidence and daily life, try checking yourself:

items.x: Forehead: wrinkles from the hairline to the eyebrows, and the wrinkles are starting to become deep
Eyebrows: the eyebrows have dropped so that the eyes and brows look too close together
Eyes: deep wrinkles around the eyes or at the outer corners, and sagging eyelids that block vision
Cheeks: sagging, skin that wrinkles and is no longer firm as before, or visibly deep marionette lines
Mouth: wrinkles at the corners of the mouth, or sagging that makes the mouth turn down, so the face no longer looks as bright as it used to
Neck: loose neck skin and visibly sagging skin under the chin, so the jawline is no longer as clear as before

blocks.x: If you check yourself against this checklist and find worrying problems, that is already a good answer that it is time to have the DFL Deep Plane Facelift surgery.
How Is the DFL Deep Plane Facelift Better Than a Traditional Facelift?

items.x: Gives a more natural-looking result
Effectively corrects deep wrinkles, sagging, and drooping facial tissue
Helps give the face more dimension and balance
Corrects problems that affect daily life, such as drooping eyelids, drooping eyebrows, and drooping mouth corners
Small incisions with scars hidden in places that cannot be seen, which removes worry about scarring
Stimulates blood and fluid circulation in the face, so the skin looks brighter and healthier
Results can last about 7 to 12 years, depending on each person's care

blocks.x: DFL Deep Plane Facelift Procedure

The DFL Deep Plane Facelift has the following steps. Consultation with a specialist doctor: The consultation is the first step, where the patient's facial skin is assessed by a specialist aesthetic plastic surgeon, who asks about concerns and expectations. The surgeon then uses this information to design the face and plan the surgery, and shows a rough preview of what the result will look like after the surgery.

Preparing before surgery: Before surgery, the surgeon gives advice on preparation, self-care, restrictions, and what to have ready on the day of surgery, and a nurse will emphasize and add to this advice.

Surgery: After the anesthesiologist puts the patient under general anesthesia, the surgeon makes incisions at the temple, along the hairline, and around the ear, then dissects the skin and the SMAS layer and releases the ligaments beneath this muscle layer, then sutures the muscle to a strong anchor. After that, the upper skin is pulled taut and the excess is cut away, before the wound is closed with fine sutures in front of or behind the ear to hide the scars.

Aftercare: After surgery, the surgeon prescribes some medication to prevent complications, so take the medication exactly as the surgeon provides it. Regarding recovery, recovery from a deep plane facelift is fairly quick, and most people can return to daily life within 1 to 2 weeks, depending on the individual.
Scars From the DFL Deep Plane Facelift

Facelift surgery today gives more importance to the scars it creates. The DFL Deep Plane Facelift is a new facelift surgery with small scars hidden in places that are hard to see. The facelift scars also do not look tight the way those from other facelifts can, because the facial muscles are lifted at a deeper layer than usual.
In the DFL Deep Plane Facelift, the surgeon hides the scars in 2 areas:

items.x: Facelift: When the face is lifted from below the eyes down to the chin, the surgeon cuts away the excess skin and hides the incision in front of the ear, where wounds heal quickly.
Neck lift: After pulling the neck skin, the surgeon cuts away the excess skin and hides the incision behind the ear, where it is hard to notice.

blocks.x: Self-Care After the DFL Deep Plane Facelift

The surgeon explains the basic self-care after a deep plane facelift in outline during the consultation or before entering the operating room, and a nurse experienced in facelift surgery gives advice and reminders again once the patient has regained consciousness. Basic self-care is as follows:

items.x: For the first 48 hours after the facelift, apply ice or a cold pack around the incisions to reduce swelling.
Wear the face wrap for support for the first 1 to 2 days after a deep plane facelift.
Avoid lying flat or lying face down for about 1 week to prevent disturbing the wounds. Sleep with your head higher than your body to reduce swelling and bruising.
If there is abnormally heavy bleeding or excessive swelling after a deep plane facelift, contact the doctor immediately.

Apex Surgery Hospital is a leader in the DFL Deep Plane Facelift, led by Dr. Somboon Waiphrip, a specialist aesthetic plastic surgeon with more than 20 years of experience in cosmetic surgery. His expertise is backed by many successful patient cases and international awards. Surgery is performed in a sterile operating room with a 10K safety standard, with an anesthesiology team and nurses who are experienced and have handled many facelift cases looking after patients, to ensure that patients are safe and receive the best possible care.
How Much Does a Deep Plane Facelift Cost at Apex Surgery Hospital?

The price of the DFL Deep Plane Facelift depends on each person's concerns. At Apex Surgery Hospital, a deep plane facelift with a neck lift costs 280,000 to 360,000 baht. The price includes 2 nights of recovery in the hospital, medicines and follow-up with the doctor. To know the exact price, it is best to first have an assessment with a specialist aesthetic plastic surgeon at Apex Surgery Hospital.
