svc:bone.title: Facial Bone Surgery at Apex Surgery | Cheekbone, Jaw, V-Line, Chin
svc:bone.desc: Facial bone surgery at Apex Surgery Hospital: cheekbone reduction, jaw reduction, V-line, genioplasty and jaw surgery, planned from an 11-point face analysis and X-rays.
svc:bone.heroAlt: Facial bone surgery at Apex Surgery Hospital
intro: Facial bone surgery changes the shape, size or position of the facial bones so the cheekbones, jaw, chin and jaws sit in proportion. It works on bone, so it suits a wide face, a strong jaw angle or a chin that sits too far back or forward when the cause is the skeleton. When the width comes from muscle or fat, another treatment may suit better, such as a muscle-relaxing injection for a large jaw muscle.

Before planning, the doctor runs an 11-point face analysis covering the hairline and forehead, the midface, the jawline, the face outline, the chin, the bite and the jaws. X-rays show the bone itself. The plan may cover one area or several in one operation.

atApex.h: Facial bone surgery at Apex Surgery
atApex.alt: Jaw surgery at Apex: scan, analyse, design, surgery

blocks.x: The doctor looks at these when the cause may be the bone:

items.x: A wide midface or cheekbones that stick out at the side
A jaw angle that stands out because of the bone
A wide lower face
A chin that is short, long, set back or off-centre
A face that is uneven because of the bone
Upper or lower jaws out of position, with or without a bite problem

sections.h: The bite and jaw position come first

blocks.x: The jaws carry the teeth, so where the upper and lower jaws sit decides how the teeth meet. That bite affects chewing, speech, the jaw joints and the shape of the lower face.

A face that looks long, set back, pushed forward or tilted is often a jaw position problem rather than a bone shape problem. Trimming the jaw angle or the chin makes the face smaller but leaves the jaws where they were, so the imbalance and the bite stay. Moving the jaws fixes both.
So before choosing between contouring and jaw surgery, the doctor checks the bite and the jaw position with photos, X-rays and a dental check. These signs mean the bite needs a look:

items.x: Front teeth that don't meet when you bite (open bite)
Lower teeth in front of the upper teeth (underbite)
Lips that need effort to close
Teeth wearing down or breaking
Pain, clicking or tiredness in the jaw joints
The chin or the middle of the teeth sitting off to one side
Trouble biting or chewing some foods

blocks.x: When only the teeth are crooked, braces or clear aligners can be enough. When the jaws themselves are out of position, jaw surgery works together with orthodontics.

sections.h: Types of facial bone surgery at Apex

items.x: Cheekbone reduction: narrows and reshapes the cheekbones for a wide midface.
Jaw reduction: reshapes the jaw angle and the lower face outline.
V-line surgery: reshapes the jaw, the sides of the lower jaw and the chin so the outline runs smoothly to the chin.
Genioplasty: moves or reshapes your own chin bone for a chin that is set back, sticks out, is long or off-centre. It uses your own bone, not an implant.
Jaw surgery (orthognathic): moves the upper jaw, the lower jaw or both, for a protruding or set-back jaw, a tilted face, an open bite or an underbite.
Combination surgery: several areas in one operation, such as cheekbone and jaw, jaw and chin, or cheekbone, jaw and chin.

sections.h: V-line chin: moving your own chin bone

blocks.x: A sliding genioplasty cuts the chin bone inside the mouth and moves it forward, back, up, down or to the middle, then fixes it with a small plate. For a V-line, the sides of the chin are narrowed at the same time so the jawline runs smoothly into a slimmer chin.
Small moves change the face a lot. A chin moved forward about 8 mm can balance the nose, lips and neck in profile. Since it uses your own bone, nothing foreign is left in the chin.

items.x: Short or set-back chin: moved forward or lengthened
Long chin: shortened
Chin off to one side: moved to the middle
Wide or square chin: narrowed for a V-line
Chin that sticks out: moved back

sections.h: Jaw surgery (OGS) with braces or Invisalign

blocks.x: Jaw surgery, or orthognathic surgery (OGS), moves the upper jaw, the lower jaw or both into a better position, sometimes with a chin move in the same operation. The plastic surgeon, the oral and maxillofacial surgeon and the orthodontist plan it together.
Teeth first
Braces or clear aligners line up the teeth on each jaw so they fit once the jaws move. This usually takes 12 to 18 months. In some cases surgery comes first and the teeth are lined up after.
Planning
Photos, X-rays or a CT scan and a dental scan set how far each jaw moves and where the bite will land.
Surgery

Under general anaesthesia, through cuts inside the mouth. The upper jaw is moved with a Le Fort I cut, the lower jaw with a split of the jaw bone (BSSO), and the bone is held with small plates and screws.
The first weeks

Most people stay in hospital for about 2 nights. Food is liquid at first, then soft, and it can take up to 4 weeks to eat normally. Most swelling settles in 2 to 3 weeks, and many people go back to work in 1 to 3 weeks.
Finishing the bite
The jaws take about 6 weeks for first healing, then braces or aligners finish the bite. Full healing of the bone takes 9 to 12 months, and a retainer keeps the teeth in place after.
Consultation and face analysis
The doctor asks about your concerns and health, then analyses the cheekbones, jaw, chin and bite.
Photos and X-rays
These show the bone lines, the jaw position and the bite before anything is planned.
A plan for your face
The doctor sets where, along which line and how much bone to change, and whether one area or several is better.
Health check
Blood tests, your conditions and medicines, and a check that you are ready for general anaesthesia.
Surgery
The operation follows the plan, under general anaesthesia with an anaesthesiologist watching your vital signs.
Recovery and follow-up
The doctor checks the wound, swelling, feeling, bone lines and healing at each visit until the face settles.

faqs.q: How long is recovery after facial bone surgery?
a: Swelling is strongest in the first 1 to 3 days, and chewing may be awkward. Swelling and bruising ease over 1 to 2 weeks. Many people go back to work in weeks 2 to 4. The face outline shows more clearly at 1 to 3 months and settles at about 3 to 6 months, depending on the type and number of areas.

faqs.q: Do I need jaw reduction to get a smaller face?
a: Not always. A wide face can come from bone, muscle, fat or a mix. If the jaw muscle is the cause, an injection to relax it may be enough. The doctor finds the cause first.

faqs.q: Is jaw reduction the same as jaw surgery?
a: No. Jaw reduction reshapes the jaw angle and outline. Jaw surgery moves the upper or lower jaw to correct how the jaws and teeth meet.

faqs.q: Can braces or Invisalign fix my jaw without surgery?
a: When only the teeth are out of line, yes. When the jaws themselves are out of position, orthodontics can move the teeth but not the jaws, so jaw surgery and orthodontics work together.

faqs.q: Will my lip and chin feel numb after jaw surgery?
a: Numbness of the lower lip and chin is common after lower jaw surgery. It usually improves over several months, but in some people it doesn't fully recover. The doctor explains the risk for your plan.

faqs.q: How long does the whole OGS process take?
a: Usually 12 to 18 months of braces or aligners before surgery, about 6 weeks of first healing after, then several more months of orthodontics to finish the bite. Full healing of the bone takes 9 to 12 months.

faqs.q: Should a short chin get an implant or genioplasty?
a: Genioplasty moves your own chin bone, while an implant adds shape on top of the bone. The doctor chooses from the length and position of your chin and how much it needs to move.

faqs.q: Has Apex done facial bone cases on Surgery Wars?
a: Yes. Khun Pop in EP4 had a sliding genioplasty, and Khun Yui in EP8 had jaw surgery for a protruding lower jaw and bite problem, planned with the dental team. Both episodes are on the Surgery Wars page.

blocks.x: Many people may assume that double eyelid surgery is only for people who have no eyelid crease, but in reality it also suits several other groups with other eye concerns, including:

items.x: People with a single eyelid: those who want a double eyelid and want the eyes to look rounder, larger, more dimensional and brighter, to build personality and confidence.
People with uneven eyelid creases: whether the creases differ in size, or one eye has a crease and the other does not, leaving the overall face looking out of proportion.

People with a hidden double eyelid: those who have a crease that is covered by the upper eyelid when the eyes are open, making the eyes look small or puffy. Double eyelid surgery makes the crease clearly visible.
People with age-related drooping eyelids: with age, the skin of the eyelids begins to sag, making the face look sad and older than its age.
People with weakened eye muscles: the eyelid drops over the iris more than normal, blocking vision and making the person look sleepy all the time.
People with too much fat in the eyelids: the eyelids look thick, bulging and puffy. Double eyelid surgery combined with removal of the excess fat makes the eyes look more beautiful.
People with eyelashes that poke into the eye: creating the eyelid crease pushes the lash margin to turn outward, reducing eye irritation and preventing long-term problems.
People who want makeup to be easier: for people who wear makeup regularly, a clear eyelid crease makes drawing eyeliner or applying eyeshadow easier and more attractive than before.

sections.h: Advantages of Celeb Eyes double eyelid surgery at Apex

blocks.x: Among the many double eyelid techniques available, Apex's Celeb Eyes technique is specially designed for a distinctive result that meets individual needs, with the following features that differ from ordinary eyelid surgery.

items.x: Eyelid crease designed for the individual: the doctor carefully assesses the facial structure, eyelid skin condition and the patient's wishes in order to design a crease that is beautiful and fits the face as closely as possible, rather than a ready-made crease.

Beautiful, smooth, natural results: with the buried-knot suture technique, double eyelid surgery creates a beautifully curved fold that blends smoothly with the skin. The knots of the thread are hidden under the skin, so the knots cannot be seen and there is almost no scarring.

Less swelling and bruising and a shorter recovery: with precise instruments and techniques that reduce trauma to the eyelid tissue, swelling and bruising after surgery are less than with traditional techniques, and patients can return to normal life sooner.

Care by a surgical team experienced with the eyes: the surgeons at Apex have experience in double eyelid surgery and in the physiology of the eye, so you can be confident in a natural-looking, beautiful result.
Solves a range of problems in one procedure: the Celeb Eyes technique creates the eyelid crease and can also address droopy eyelids, excess eyelid fat or weakened eye muscles in the same procedure.

blocks.x: Eye bag surgery removes or repositions the fat that bulges under the eye, and trims loose skin when needed. It suits fat bulges, loose lower lid skin and eye bags that run in the family, including in young people. It does not fix puffiness from kidney disease, allergies or lack of sleep.

items.x: Inside the lower lid: for fat with little loose skin. No outer scar.
Along the lash line: for fat with loose skin, which is trimmed at the same time.
Hidden lash-line technique: the method Apex uses, with the scar kept close to the lashes.

blocks.x: Stitches come out on day 4 to 7. Most people go back to work in week 2, and the result settles at 1 to 3 months. Use cold compresses for the first 1 to 2 days, sleep on 2 to 3 pillows, and skip makeup and contact lenses for 2 weeks. Ptosis means the muscle that lifts the eyelid is weak, so the lid covers more of the eye than it should. A normal lid covers the top 1 to 2 mm of the iris. In severe cases it reaches the pupil, and people raise their brows or lift their chin to see. A double eyelid crease alone does not fix this, so the muscle is tightened in the same operation.

items.x: Age-related ptosis: the muscle stretches with age. It does not get better by itself.
Ptosis from birth: the muscle is weak from childhood. Dr. Narong treats congenital and revision cases.
Medical causes: drooping that comes with myasthenia gravis, stroke or diabetes needs a medical check before surgery.

blocks.x: Epicanthoplasty opens a thick fold of skin at the inner corner of the eye, so the eyes look wider and the crease runs more clearly. Not everyone needs it. The doctor looks at the size of the fold, the curve of the crease and the distance between the eyes, since opening too much makes the eyes look sharp.

items.x: Z-plasty or W-plasty: for a thick, tight fold.
Short hidden incision: for a mild fold.

faqs.q: How many years does double eyelid surgery last?

faqs.q: How many days of recovery are needed after double eyelid surgery?

faqs.q: Is general anesthesia needed for double eyelid surgery?

faqs.q: What should I avoid eating after double eyelid surgery?
a: Avoid foods that may trigger inflammation and affect wound healing, such as seafood, pickled foods and strongly spiced hot foods, and avoid alcohol and smoking for at least 2 weeks.

faqs.q: Can double eyelid surgery fix drooping eyelids?
a: Only when the cause is loose skin or fat. When the lid muscle is weak, the doctor tightens the muscle as part of the same operation. A check of how far the lid opens tells the two apart.

faqs.q: How long is recovery after eye bag surgery?

Thighs: can be done on the inner thighs, to deal with thighs that rub together, and on the outer thighs, to reduce the saddlebags. Liposuction gives the legs a beautiful, well-proportioned line.
Waist and back: areas where fat collects as a spare tire or as fat that bulges at the edge of the bra. Liposuction gives the body more curves and a slimmer look.
Chin and jaw: fat under the chin is hard to remove. Liposuction here makes the jawline look sharper and the face visibly slimmer.

Hips and buttocks: suitable for people who want to reduce hips that flare too wide so they are in proportion with the body. Liposuction also helps sculpt the buttocks to look rounder and more attractive.
Calves: for people whose large calves come from accumulated fat rather than muscle. Liposuction can reduce the size of the calves and make the legs look slimmer and longer.

faqs.q: How many months must a compression garment be worn after liposuction?
a: Doctors generally recommend wearing the compression garment 22 to 24 hours a day in the first week, then 12 to 18 hours a day in weeks 2 to 4, so that the skin tightens back into shape as well as possible.

faqs.q: How long until abdominal liposuction results settle?
a: During the first 1 to 3 months, the body proportions visibly shrink and the figure settles more clearly, but the result settles completely and looks its best once the body has fully recovered, at 3 to 6 months or more.

faqs.q: How many days after liposuction can I drive?
a: Most people can drive again once they stop taking sedating painkillers, which is usually 3 to 7 days after the procedure, or when they feel the body can move comfortably.

faqs.q: How many days until swelling goes down after liposuction?
a: Swelling decreases noticeably during the first 2 to 4 weeks after surgery, but internal swelling may remain and will gradually subside until it is completely gone in 3 to 6 months.

intro: APEX Surgery Hospital is a leader in rhinoplasty, especially OPEN rhinoplasty, performed by doctors who specialize in nose surgery. APEX Surgery Hospital also uses the OPEN rhinoplasty technique with fine cartilage, and the Clip On developed by Dr. Somboon Waiphrip, which gives a strong nose with a natural-looking shape and a high level of safety. In addition, with the surgeon's expertise, nose shapes are designed to suit each person's face shape, so the results look distinctive and suited to each person. APEX Surgery Hospital also performs surgery with modern technology and medical equipment, in operating rooms that meet standards equivalent to those of large hospitals.

As for patient care, APEX Surgery Hospital provides holistic care from before surgery through recovery, so that patients can be confident that after OPEN rhinoplasty at APEX they will go home with the most satisfying results.

blocks.x: Rhinoplasty programs use a variety of techniques to meet different needs and nose structure problems, as follows.

items.x: People who want more dimension and height in the nose: people with a flat nose or a low bridge, which leaves the face lacking dimension. Rhinoplasty adds height so the face looks sharper and better proportioned.
People with complex structural problems: this group includes people with an abnormal nose structure, such as a crooked nose, a high hump or a large tip, which require detailed structural correction.

People with problems from a previous rhinoplasty: people who have had a nose procedure before and developed problems such as a tilted silicone implant, a thin tip or an implant that has pierced through, and who need revision for a better result.
People who want to reshape the nose tip: people who want to correct a short, blunt or bulbous tip so that it becomes slender, projecting and well shaped, for example a teardrop shape.

People who want nostril wings in proportion: for people with wide or flared nostril wings, surgery to reduce the size of the nostril wings alongside the procedure helps the whole nose look slimmer and better balanced with the face.

faqs.q: How many days of recovery are needed after rhinoplasty?
a: After rhinoplasty or surgery, allow at least 7 to 14 days of recovery, a period that calls for care and strict adherence to the doctor's advice. After about 2 weeks, swelling and scars begin to ease, and the result is clearly visible from 3 to 6 months, and the shape finishes settling at 6 to 12 months.

faqs.q: How many days until the nose shape sets after rhinoplasty?
a: Generally, the nose begins to set, or a clearer shape appears, within 1 to 3 months after rhinoplasty, and the shape finishes setting completely in the period of 6 to 12 months, depending on each person's skin condition and swelling after surgery.

faqs.q: What can I eat after rhinoplasty?
a: You can eat normally, but during the first 1 to 2 weeks after surgery, focus on soft foods that are easy to chew and digest and high in nutrition. Avoid strongly flavored foods, pickled foods, and hard or very hot foods, to reduce the risk of inflammation and help the wound heal faster.

faqs.q: Can rhinoplasty be done with little nasal tissue?
a: People with little nasal tissue can have rhinoplasty, but there are limits on how high or projecting the nose can be made. To keep the result natural, the surgeon often uses techniques such as placing cartilage from behind the ear or other tissue under the nose tip, to reduce the risk of the implant piercing through.

blocks.x: Meet Khun Da, the first makeover case on the show

Khun Da said she felt delighted and very happy. At 60, she still had the chance to have surgery to build her confidence. She likes taking photos, but after an accident she felt unsure of herself when she smiled.
When she came for a consultation at APEX Hospital, the team welcomed her and looked after her well. They analysed her face with modern medical equipment before planning her treatment.
The APEX doctors work on Khun Da's makeover
The APEX team analysed the problems in Khun Da's face and gave this advice:

items: Khun Da shows quite a lot of gum when she smiles, so she needs gum contouring to make her teeth look taller, plus veneers and root canal treatment.
Her face is angular, lacks fat and has wrinkles, so the doctors planned a facelift, a neck lift, a brow lift, a forehead lift and an eyelid lift, together with a chin implant made of silicone.

blocks.x: Khun Da told the doctors what she hoped for: a younger-looking face, as if she were 30 to 40 years old. The doctors promised to take care of her and do their best.
The results after surgery and the studio's reaction

blocks.alt: The results after surgery and the studio's reaction

blocks.x: After the surgery, the show played the Before and After photos and introduced Khun Da. Many people on the show were amazed by her result, including:

items: Khun Nat Nisamanee and Khun Rassamikae, who both said “wow”.
Khun Ice Apissada, who said in her interview that she never expected such a change. Khun Da looked so young that nothing was left of her old face shape, and she could no longer be called “auntie”.

Khun Lukkade Metinee, who said she was very beautiful and did not look like a 60-year-old woman. Her skin looked good and her face and neck were firm. She said this changes a life. She added that she believed Khun Da would be happy in her daily life, would want to dress up and go out to meet people, and that she was very happy for her.

Eyes: Subbrow Lift and double eyelid surgery together with a correction for weak eyelid muscle (ptosis)

war:2.title: APEX Surgery Wars EP2: Fixing Khun Pipo's Nose and Rebalancing the Face
war:2.seo: APEX Surgery Wars EP2: Nose Revision and Face Rebalancing for Khun Pipo
war:2.desc: Apex Surgery Wars EP2: Khun Pipo had a narrow nostril and trouble breathing after three nose surgeries. See how the APEX team planned the care.

blocks.alt: APEX Surgery Wars EP2: nose revision and face rebalancing for Khun Pipo

blocks.x: Apex Surgery Wars EP2 follows “Khun Pipo”, 30, who has had nose augmentation and nose revision surgery three times. One nostril is still narrow, the nostrils are uneven, and breathing is not fully comfortable.

The doctors from APEX Surgery Hospital planned to correct the structure of the nose and to look after the proportions of the face, neck, skin and hair. The aim was to ease the worry about breathing and give Khun Pipo more confidence in daily life.
From a nose problem to a chance for change

In this episode of Surgery Wars, the hosts were Khun Meen Peerawit and Khun Nui Thanawat. They opened with a VTR (pre-recorded profile video) of Khun Pipo, the first APEX Surgery Hospital contestant of the episode. Khun Pipo explained why they applied to join the show:
“I saw a chance to change and fix a problem I had worried about for a long time, my nose and my breathing. So I applied to the show.”
The main problem came after several earlier nose surgeries. One nostril was so narrow that it was almost closed, so Khun Pipo could only breathe through one nostril.
The doctors plan to fix the narrow nostril by rebuilding the structure

blocks.alt: The APEX doctors and Khun Rassamikae on Surgery Wars

blocks.x: Dr. Somboon explained that the key issue in this case is breathing trouble after three nose surgeries. One nostril is clearly narrow, so the doctors had to assess the outside shape, the inside, the old scars and the airway together.
The doctor planned an open rhinoplasty with rib cartilage. This opens up the inner structure and allows the misshapen areas to be corrected. The goal is to make the nose and nostrils better balanced.
The doctors also took body weight into account, so Khun Pipo received weight care alongside the surgery plan.
The challenge of revising a nose with old scars

blocks.alt: Khun Pipo before surgery with APEX

blocks.x: A nose that has had several operations usually has more internal scar tissue and adhesions than a first operation. The tissue layers have to be separated and the scars trimmed carefully, so that the skin, blood vessels and any structures that still work are not harmed.

Dr. Somboon explained that the hard parts of Khun Pipo's case are dealing with the old scars and stopping the nostril from narrowing again. So the surgery is not only about making the nose bridge look sharper. It has to build a strong structure and keep the nostrils wide enough for breathing.
Planning facial proportions to suit who Khun Pipo is
Besides the nose, the doctors looked at the structure of the whole face. Khun Pipo wanted a softer face that fits more closely with their own image.
The doctors planned to adjust several details together, such as the hairline, forehead, eyes, lips and skin quality, so that all the parts look connected.
Khun Pipo's surgery programme
Khun Pipo was planned for surgery and care on several parts of the face at once. The main procedures were:

items: Open rhinoplasty revision with rib cartilage
Fat grafting to the forehead and face
Liposuction of the jawline, cheeks and under the chin
Tightening sutures under the chin and in the neck muscles
Adjusting the proportions of the chin and lips
Care for skin quality and sagging
Hairline adjustment with a hair transplant

blocks.x: Khun Pipo said the surgery had many steps and took about 7 to 8 hours in the operating room, which was very exciting. Khun Pipo saw it as a chance to fix the things they worried about and see a change for the better.
Skin and sagging care after the structural work

For skin care, Dr. O planned a botulinum toxin programme for the face, neck and shoulders, together with ultrasound and radiofrequency energy devices, to treat skin quality in the areas that were assessed. Khun Pipo's programme included:

items: Botulinum toxin for the face, neck and shoulders
Voluma filler for the chin, 2 cc
Volbella and Volift fillers for the lips

blocks.alt: Before and After of Khun Pipo after surgery with APEX on Surgery Wars

blocks.x: After the treatment and recovery period, the show revealed Khun Pipo with the before and after photos, to the excitement of the hosts, the Celeb Master and the others on the show.
Khun Nui Sujira said “You're smiling now”, and Khun Lukkade Metinee said “So beautiful”.

Khun Rassamikae, the Celeb Master for this episode, said Khun Pipo's face now looks softer, and that more confidence and ease can be seen. She congratulated Khun Pipo on finally fixing a problem that had worried them for so long.
What matters most is more than what can be seen

Khun Pipo said that before treatment there was often a sound when breathing and only one nostril worked. After the surgery, breathing felt clearer, in the direction they had hoped for.
“When I could breathe through both nostrils, I felt this is the breathing I had been waiting for.”
Khun Pipo also said this change added confidence, both in daily life and in appearance. People around them noticed the change and said the face looked fresher.
Care that looks beyond appearance

blocks.alt: Khun Pipo's review after surgery with APEX on Surgery Wars

blocks.x: Khun Pipo thanked the APEX doctors and staff, saying that what they received was more than a change in appearance. It felt like the doctors were helping to fix a problem that affects real daily life.
“APEX didn't just look at making me beautiful. I felt they came to treat me.”

Khun Rassamikae added that this case opens a new view of plastic surgery. People who have surgery are not only those who want to change how they look. Surgery can also help fix problems from an earlier operation that affect daily life.
Summary of APEX Surgery Wars EP2
Khun Pipo's case shows that, besides surgery to look better, the APEX doctors care about solving the individual problems patients worry about, so they can live with confidence again.

war:3.title: 365mc on Surgery Wars EP3: Liposuction for Khun Adam, Turning Teasing into Confidence
war:3.seo: 365mc on Surgery Wars EP3: Liposuction for Khun Adam
war:3.desc: 365mc, led by Dr. Jan, joined APEX on Surgery Wars EP3 to care for Khun Adam with liposuction of the under-chin area, chest, abdomen, waist and back.

blocks.alt: 365mc on Surgery Wars EP3: liposuction for Khun Adam

blocks.x: 365mc, led by Dr. Jan, joined the APEX Surgery Hospital doctors on Surgery Wars EP3 on Workpoint 23. They took care of the body makeover of “Khun Adam”, a 27-year-old man who had been teased about his body, face and skin colour since childhood. The teasing affected his confidence and how he dressed.
Chest and fat deposits that worried him about his body shape

Before treatment, Khun Adam was worried about a chest that looked bulging and pointed. He often walked with his shoulders hunched and did not dare to dress the way he wanted. He also had fat deposits on his abdomen, waist, hips and back. The doctors planned liposuction to adjust his proportions, so that he could get closer to the body he wanted and feel confident in himself again.
Dr. Jan leads the 365mc team to care for the case with APEX

blocks.alt: Dr. Jan leads the 365mc team to care for the case with APEX

blocks.x: For Surgery Wars EP3, Dr. Pichaya Euawongprayoon, known as Dr. Jan, represented 365mc and brought its doctors to plan the liposuction and reshape Khun Adam's body together with the APEX doctors.

365mc handled the main part of the work, a full-body makeover by liposuction: the under-chin area, chest, abdomen, waist and back. The goal was a balanced overall shape that answered Khun Adam's worries.
Full-body makeover with 76 LAMS of liposuction

After assessing his body, the doctors found that several areas should be treated together, so that the front, sides and back look connected, without focusing on fat in just one spot. Khun Adam's liposuction plan was divided into:

items: JAWLINE, 2 LAMS: liposuction under the chin, to make the jawline look sharper
CHEST, 13 LAMS: liposuction of the chest, to adjust a chest that looked bulging and pointed
ABDOMEN & WAIST, 41 LAMS: liposuction of the abdomen and waist, to adjust the midsection
BACK, 20 LAMS: liposuction of the back, so that the front and back proportions look connected

blocks.x: The total was 76 LAMS. The number of LAMS is planned from the amount of fat, the body shape and how well each area connects with the next. The right number differs from person to person.
The liposuction technique at 365mc

Dr. Jan explained that the liposuction uses small cannulas. The doctors place them according to Khun Adam's amount of fat and body shape, so the wounds are small and he can return to daily life within the recovery period the doctors assess. The doctors also look after skin firmness, so that the overall shape comes out more clearly.

blocks.alt: Khun Adam, Before, After and Final Look

blocks.x: Care for body shape, hair and skin problems
Besides the liposuction at 365mc, the APEX doctors planned several other treatments for Khun Adam:

items: Hair transplant to adjust the hairline and make the face frame look sharper
EM NEO on the abdomen, waist and back
Pico All Mode on the chest and back
Treatment AHA and Ultra Bright on the front and back

blocks.x: For the dark marks from acne on his back, the doctors chose a pigment laser programme together with skin care. For the abdomen, they used electromagnetic energy to stimulate the muscles and support the body-shaping plan.
A new look for someone who did not dare to dress up
When the after photos were revealed, the others on the show responded to Khun Adam, especially to how much clearer his chest, waist and abdomen looked.
Khun Adam said he had once given up hope of shaping his body, because he could not balance work, exercise and daily life. Being chosen for the show felt like a chance to get closer to his goal.

blocks.alt: Before and After of Khun Adam after liposuction

blocks.x: After the treatment, people around him began to say that his body had changed. His old trousers felt looser, and he could choose clothes and live more as himself. He used to walk with his shoulders hunched because he worried about his chest. Today he feels he can walk and carry himself with more poise.
Summary of Khun Adam's change with 365mc

365mc planned 76 LAMS of liposuction for Khun Adam, covering the under-chin area, chest, abdomen, waist and back. The focus was on the bulging chest and the fat deposits in several areas that hurt his confidence.

He went from teasing that kept him from dressing the way he wanted to caring for his body in his own way. The change was about more than proportions. It also let Khun Adam live more as himself than before.

war:4.title: APEX Surgery Wars EP4: Mask Off, a New Look and Khun Pop's New Confidence
war:4.seo: APEX Surgery Wars EP4: Khun Pop Goes from Self-Doubt to a New Look
war:4.desc: APEX Surgery Wars EP4: Khun Pop Orapan hid behind a mask and avoided photos. See her personal plan for surgery, skin and teeth.

blocks.alt: APEX SURGERY WARS EP4 Khun Pop

blocks.x: In Surgery Wars EP4, APEX presents the idea DEFINE ELEGANCE: natural beauty, Confidence Upgrade. The episode tells the story of “Khun Pop”, a 25-year-old nursing assistant who avoided having her photo taken, did not dare to look people in the eye, and wore a face mask to hide her lack of confidence.
The APEX doctors on Surgery Wars EP4

The APEX Surgery Hospital doctors did not adjust just one part of Khun Pop's face. Surgeons, skin doctors and dentists assessed her together, to plan changes to the facial structure, the smile and the skin that suit Khun Pop, the winner of this episode.
The doctors who took care of Khun Pop, the winner of Surgery Wars EP4, were:

items: Dr. Ruangyot Onsaard (dental licence no. 2677), a dentist from TDH Dental

blocks.x: A start from self-doubt that cost her many chances

At the start of the show, Khun Pop, the winner of Surgery Wars EP4, came to APEX Surgery Hospital and described feelings that had built up over a long time. She was not confident about her face, did not dare to have her photo taken, and felt she had many flaws. She had only a few photos of herself even on her phone.

blocks.alt: Khun Pop during a challenge on Surgery Wars EP4

blocks.x: When everyone had to wear face masks, Khun Pop felt she dared to talk and mix with people more, because the mask covered the parts of her face she worried about. When she had to take it off, her lack of confidence came back.

Khun Pop admitted that she used to fear criticism or bullying about her looks, so she rarely dared to look at other people. At that time she saw the mask as the best way to hide what she was unsure about.
Analysing the facial structure for a personal plan by the APEX doctors

Dr. Somboon Waiphrip explained that the middle part of Khun Pop's face is rather sunken. This makes the area around the mouth look turned down and the lower face shorter than the upper face. So the plan had to consider the nose, the nasolabial area, the chin, the line of the teeth and the overall proportions of the face together.

blocks.alt: Khun Pop before surgery with APEX, Surgery Wars EP4

blocks.x: APEX does not look only at surgery. Skin doctors and doctors who reshape the face also joined the assessment, to design a care plan that fits each person's structure and problems.

“Besides the nose, we have to help the middle of the face project forward in a suitable way. When this works together with adjusting the angle of the teeth, the overall proportions look more balanced.”
Before the process began, Khun Pop said she was very excited. She had never been assessed and cared for this way before, so she could not yet picture how she would look after the change.
Planning the smile with TDH Dental
One of the key parts of this case is the line of the teeth and the smile. Dr. Ruangyot Onsaard from TDH Dental planned Invisalign clear aligners within a limited time.

blocks.alt: Khun Pop on a clear aligner programme with TDH Dental

blocks.x: Khun Pop had worn braces for several years, but her teeth were still not in line. The dentists planned to straighten the crowded and crooked teeth, reduce the angle of teeth that stick out from the line of the face, and adjust the level of the teeth to fit the facial structure after surgery.
“One thing we will do is help her show her smile and feel more confident.”
So the teeth straightening was not done separately from reshaping the face. It is part of a plan that helps the teeth, lips, chin and the whole face work together better.
Surgery to reshape Khun Pop's facial structure
From the assessment, the doctors planned surgery on several areas to adjust the facial proportions to suit Khun Pop's original structure:

items: Rib cartilage implants in the nasolabial area
Upper eyelid surgery, with care for weak eyelid muscle (ptosis) as assessed
Fat grafting to balance the face
Liposuction of the face and neck
Genioplasty (chin bone repositioning) to adjust the proportions of the lower face

blocks.x: Dr. Somboon explained that adding dimension to the nose in this case needed support from the middle of the face. So rib cartilage was placed beside the nose, in the paranasal area, to add projection to the middle of the face. The chin bone was also moved down to make the face look longer and more balanced.

The doctors also planned to define the jawline and reduce fat deposits on the face and neck. They also treated the eyes, which had slightly weak eyelid muscles, together with double eyelid surgery, so that the eyes look more open and bright in a suitable way.

blocks.alt: Khun Pop before and after surgery with APEX, Surgery Wars EP4

blocks.x: Bringing out her own features, not turning her into someone else

Dr. Poranee Chatthani, known as Dr. Oeng, one of the doctors who planned the aesthetic care, explained that the care had to be personalised. Khun Pop still had to look like herself, so the plan chose to bring out her existing good features more clearly.

Khun Pop's best feature is her round eyes, so the doctors wanted the eye area to look brighter. At the same time, they planned to remove fat under the chin so that the jawline looks sharper, and to adjust skin quality to suit the facial structure after surgery.
The skin and face-reshaping programme used in this case was:
From hiding behind a mask to revealing a new look

Before the reveal of the after look, the host Khun Nui Thanawat said that Khun Pop used to be a shy woman who lacked confidence and wore a mask all the time. Today she was about to meet a different chapter of her life.

blocks.alt: Khun Pop, the APEX winner, is revealed on Surgery Wars EP4

blocks.x: When the Before photo appeared, before Khun Pop walked out with her new look, the reactions of the Master Celebs on the show showed a clear change.

Khun Pop said that since she took off the mask and dared to show herself more, people around her said she looked very different. The most important thing was not only compliments on her looks. It was that she now dared to leave home without makeup or a mask hiding her, as she used to.
Confidence that reaches the people around her

Khun Ice, the Master Celeb for the APEX team in this episode, talked about the day she first met Khun Pop. Khun Pop looked sad, hardly looked at anyone and did not dare to express herself. After the care and follow-up, Khun Pop began to have a bright smile and talk with the people around her more.

blocks.alt: The APEX doctors and Khun Ice, Master Celeb, on Surgery Wars EP4

blocks.x: “When people are happy from the inside, that happiness spreads to the people around them. Today I can't help smiling along with her.”
The doctors also saw a change every time Khun Pop came back for a check-up. She used to hardly look at people or talk. Step by step, she began to express herself with more confidence and energy.
Khun Pop's words after the change

At first Khun Pop's mother did not agree with her joining the show, but Khun Pop was determined to prove that she could get past the fear and lack of confidence she had had for a long time. Before the care began, she said:
“Today I may not be who I hope to be yet, but from now on I will be a new person, more confident than before.”
After the surgery, skin and dental teams planned her care together, and Khun Pop thanked APEX Surgery Hospital for the opportunity.
“I was a child with no confidence back then. I didn't dare to talk to people or smile at people. Today... I dare.”
Summary of APEX Surgery Wars EP4

The story of Khun Pop, APEX's winner on Surgery Wars EP4, shows that a lack of confidence can affect life more than the people around can see: not daring to have her photo taken, not daring to look people in the eye, and even avoiding important chances in life.

So the care for this case started by listening to what Khun Pop worried about, then analysing her facial structure in detail so that every part fits together and her own identity is kept. Who will be APEX's winning contestant in the next episode? Follow Surgery Wars every Monday at 9:15 pm.

war:5.title: APEX Surgery Wars EP5 Gives Khun Aiya the Femininity She Chose
war:5.seo: APEX Surgery Wars EP5 gives Khun Aiya a softer, more feminine look
war:5.desc: Follow Khun Aiya's makeover in APEX Surgery Wars EP5, with a Feminization Design plan for her face, breasts and body proportions.

blocks.alt: APEX Surgery Wars EP5 gives Khun Aiya a softer, more feminine look

blocks.x: APEX Surgery Wars EP5 follows Khun Aiya, a 22-year-old contestant who wanted a complete image makeover so that her face, smile and body proportions would fit her femininity better, under the concept Perfecting HER, elegant in the way she chooses.
The medical team planned her care together, from the facial structure, forehead, eyes, nose, lips and teeth to the breasts and the proportions of the torso, so that each detail supports the others.
From Bullying to Choosing Her Own Beauty

Before joining the show, Khun Aiya had been bullied for looking like a monkey. She was also unhappy with her wide forehead, and this hurt her confidence. She wanted a softer, more feminine image while keeping her own identity.

blocks.alt: Khun Aiya during a mission on Surgery Wars EP5

blocks.x: This is the heart of Surgery Wars EP5. Surgery is not about becoming someone else. It is about designing beauty that fits who you are, after an assessment, and with the limits and risks understood before the decision is made.
Perfecting HER Is Not About Becoming Someone Else
Khun Aiya's main goals were to add softness to the face, balance the face outline and proportions, and create body curves that match the image she wants.

The medical team used the Feminization Design approach to work out which areas should gain dimension, which should be reduced in width or prominence, and which should be repositioned. They looked at how the whole structure relates, rather than following a ready-made pattern.
Designing a Softer Face: Why the Whole Structure Matters
The team explained that a feminine-looking face comes from how many elements relate to each other, for example:

items: Distance from the brows to the hairline
Length of the middle of the face
Line of the teeth and jaw

blocks.x: When these elements are balanced, the face looks gentler and softer without having to change the identity of the person who owns it.

blocks.alt: Khun Aiya before and after surgery at APEX

blocks.x: Feminization Design: Planning Surgery from the Face to the Body Proportions
Khun Aiya's care plan covered many areas. The details and the order of treatment were designed from the contestant's actual structure, as follows.
1. Reshaping the forehead and fat grafting to the face

The forehead was one of Khun Aiya's main concerns. The team planned to reduce the size of the forehead and place a small silicone implant in a suitable position. They also planned fat grafting to the face so that the transition between the forehead, temples and mid-face looks more continuous.
2. Forehead and mid-face lift with Endotine

The team chose Endotine for the forehead and cheek lift to hold and support the tissue in the planned position. This helps open up the eye area and lift the mid-face so the overall look is brighter and softer, while keeping the face's movement and proportions suited to her original structure.
3. Open rhinoplasty and a lip lift with Bullhorn
The mid-face was a key part of this design. The team planned an open rhinoplasty to adjust the bridge, tip and base of the nose so they fit with the forehead, eyes and chin.

At the same time, a lip lift to define the Cupid's bow was done with the Bullhorn technique, which shortens the distance between the base of the nose and the upper lip. This gives the lips better proportions and adds sweetness to the mid-face.
4. Genioplasty and buccal fat removal

Khun Aiya's lower face involved the position of the chin, the width of the cheeks and how they relate to the teeth. The team planned to reposition the chin bone in both size and position. Buccal fat was also removed so that the length and side lines of the face are better balanced.
5. Invisalign clear aligners and smile design

blocks.alt: Khun Aiya having clear aligner treatment at TDH Dental

blocks.x: The smile is another key part of Feminization Design, since the position of the teeth, the bite and the line of the jaw all affect the lips, chin and the overall face. Besides facial surgery, the dental team from TDH Dental, led by Dr. Ruangyot, took part in the treatment plan. They used Invisalign clear aligners and adjusted the position of the teeth and the smile design to fit the facial surgery plan.
6. Giving the waist and hips more curve

The team from 365mc Thailand, led by Dr. Jan, planned liposuction of the waist through small incisions with a cannula. Suitable fat was then prepared and grafted to the hips so that the waist and hip lines show a clearer curve. A specialised procedure to adjust the torso frame or rib structure was also planned to suit Khun Aiya's body shape.
7. Breast augmentation with Motiva Demi 245 cc

To add proportion to the upper body, the team planned breast augmentation with a Motiva Demi implant of 245 cc. The size was chosen from an analysis of the breast base, the width of the torso and the overall body shape, so the breasts are balanced with the shoulders, waist and hips.
8. Brightening the skin

To improve smoothness and skin health, the plan included laser hair removal on the arms, legs, face and underarms, together with Vitaran 3 syringes, Filler 1 syringe and HArmonyCa 2 syringes, to care for skin quality and hydration in line with the overall makeover plan.
An Image Makeover with Doctors from Many Specialties

The face, teeth and body are related. Changes to the chin, the teeth, the breasts, the waist or the hips have to be considered against the overall proportions. Khun Aiya's case was therefore a joint effort by the following doctors:

blocks.alt: The APEX medical team working with 365mc Thailand and TDH Dental

items: Dr. Somboon Waiphrip (licence no. 22713), plastic surgeon at APEX Surgery Hospital
Dr. Pichaya Euawongprayoon (licence no. 38451) from 365mc Thailand
Dr. Ruangyot Onsaard (dental licence no. 2677) from TDH Dental

blocks.x: Several other doctors also took part. Together they assessed when each step should be done, which structures needed to be prepared first, and how to follow the changes in the face, teeth and body, so that correcting one area does not affect the plan for another.
The Reveal After 3 Months, with an Image That Is Still Aiya
At the Before and After reveal about 3 months after surgery, the people on the show were impressed by Khun Aiya's change.

blocks.alt: Khun Aiya's reveal 3 months after surgery at APEX

blocks.x: Khun Nat Anipon, the Master Celeb for the APEX team, said that although the brief was complex, the result does not look foreign to who she was, and the most visible thing is the added softness.
For Khun Aiya, what mattered as much as the outside change was hearing people around her say she looks softer and more like a woman.
More Than a Change of Appearance, Taking Pride in Herself Again

At the end of the show, Khun Aiya thanked the medical team, APEX Surgery Hospital, Khun Nat the Master Celeb and the Surgery Wars show. She said the surgery let her be herself in the way she wants and made her feel prouder of herself.

blocks.alt: Khun Nat talking about APEX on Surgery Wars EP5

blocks.x: The surgery on the show was more than a competition. It was about one person being given the chance to say “how she wants to see herself”. Being heard by a medical team who took that wish and analysed it against her real body structure meant a great deal to her.
Summary

Khun Aiya's change in APEX Surgery Wars EP5 was an adjustment toward a more feminine look, and also a comprehensive treatment that combined medical science, the experience of a multi-specialty team and an understanding of the patient's goals, while keeping Khun Aiya's own identity.
The meaningful result is therefore the visible change and also the confidence and pride of being herself in the way she chose, in line with the concept Perfecting HER, elegant in the way she chooses.

war:6.title: APEX Surgery Wars EP6 Restores Khun Mes's Confidence After Her Body Changed Following Childbirth
war:6.seo: APEX Surgery Wars EP6 restores the body of Khun Mes, a new mother
war:6.desc: Khun Mes's postpartum recovery in APEX Surgery Wars EP6: breast lift and augmentation, tummy tuck, liposuction and revision rhinoplasty, plus skin care.

blocks.alt: APEX Surgery Wars EP6 restores the body of Khun Mes, a new mother

blocks.x: APEX Surgery Wars EP6 tells the story of a change under the concept “Mommy Confidence Comeback, restoring confidence after childbirth”. Khun Mes Ewarin, 32, wanted to look after herself again and feel confident again, after her body and proportions changed in several areas.
Khun Mes's Concerns Before the Change
Khun Mes was one of the contestants coached by Khun Ong Khemarat. She won her mission and earned the chance to have her body and image planned with the APEX medical team.

blocks.alt: Khun Mes during a mission on Surgery Wars EP6

blocks.x: Khun Mes opened up about one moment that made her start feeling unsure about her body after having a child. Her child once asked, “Mum, why are your breasts so long?” Khun Mes joked, “It's gravity, sweetheart.” Behind that answer, she admitted, “I played it off as a joke, but inside it really hurt.”
Changes After Childbirth That Affected Her Confidence

blocks.alt: Khun Mes before her body contouring at APEX on Surgery Wars EP6

blocks.x: After pregnancy and childbirth, Khun Mes's body changed in several areas. Her breasts lost firmness, her abdomen was loose, and fat had built up on her back and thighs. The goal of this case was therefore to restore several areas so that her overall proportions look balanced again.
APEX Surgery Wars EP6 and the Confidence Comeback Brief
Because several areas of Khun Mes's body needed adjusting, she was cared for by several APEX doctors with specialist experience in different fields.

blocks.alt: The APEX medical team on Surgery Wars EP6

items: Dr. Somboon Waiphrip (licence no. 22713), plastic surgeon, Chief Medical Officer and Head Surgeon at Apex Surgery Hospital
Dr. Pichaya Euawongprayoon (Dr. Jan, licence no. 38451), specialist in liposuction and body contouring, from 365mc Thailand
Dr. Jira Kunakornwong (Dr. O, licence no. 41082), specialist in dermatology, aesthetic medicine and facial contouring, at Apex Medical Center

blocks.x: The Surgery Program That Restored Khun Mes's Body After Childbirth

The medical team planned together, caring for each area as suited each procedure, so that every step connects with her overall proportions. The main goal of this case was to reshape her changed figure into firmer, more attractive proportions, while looking after Khun Mes's skin at the same time.

blocks.alt: Khun Mes's postpartum body surgery program at APEX

blocks.x: 1. Breast lift with breast augmentation

One of Khun Mes's main problems was a change in breast shape, with sagging from breastfeeding. Dr. Somboon planned a breast lift with a T-shaped incision together with breast augmentation using a Motiva Ergonomix implant of 190 cc. This program lifts the breasts to a suitable position and adds volume so the chest looks full and in proportion again.
2. Tummy tuck to firm the abdomen

Khun Mes's abdomen had clear looseness and stretch marks after pregnancy. The doctors assessed that a tummy tuck was needed to deal with the excess skin and reshape the abdomen. The doctor had to assess this together with her waist and torso proportions so the surgical approach suits Khun Mes's body.
3. Liposuction of the back to shape the waist and torso

Looking at proportions from the front alone is not enough, because the shape of the waist connects with the back and the sides of the torso. Khun Mes was therefore planned for liposuction of the back, to make the proportions around her torso fit better with the abdomen and waist.
4. Arm liposuction to shape the upper arms

The upper arms were another area where Khun Mes wanted better proportions. Dr. Jan planned liposuction with the LAMS technique, which uses a small cannula to treat fat in a specific area. This helps shape the upper arms into better proportion and meets Khun Mes's wish to wear sleeveless tops with more confidence.
5. Thigh lift and liposuction around the legs to shape the lower body

Another key area of body contouring in APEX Surgery Wars EP6 was the thighs, where Khun Mes had both skin and fat that had to be assessed together. The treatment plan therefore combined a thigh lift with thigh liposuction and tightening, to bring the lower body into better proportion with the torso.
6. Revision open rhinoplasty to adjust the facial features

Besides the body changes, Khun Mes also had her nose revised with open rhinoplasty, to adjust her existing nose structure to suit the proportions of her face. With this approach the doctor can assess and correct the internal structure in more detail than by adjusting only the outer shape.

blocks.alt: Khun Mes before and after surgery at APEX

blocks.x: Skin Care and Firming Alongside the Body Contouring
Besides surgery, Dr. O's team also planned an aesthetics program to look after skin quality and firmness, adding radiance and smoothness. The program Khun Mes received included:

items: Volnewmer 700 shots, using monopolar RF energy to stimulate collagen change and add firmness to the skin. It suits areas that are starting to sag.
Ultraformer MPT 800 shots, using focused ultrasound at a chosen depth to help firmness and make the face outline look clearer.
Vitaran 3 cc, 2 sessions, a skin quality program focused on hydration, smoothness and skin renewal, so the skin overall looks brighter and healthier.
Botox 50 units, used to reduce muscle activity in the positions judged suitable. It helps with expression lines and fine adjustments to the face.
Profhilo 1 cc, a bio-remodelling treatment that adds hydration and supports skin quality from within, so the skin looks plumper, smoother and more elastic.
Light therapy, 2 sessions, used as part of skin care after the other treatments. It aims to soothe the skin and support skin recovery according to the doctor's care plan.

blocks.x: The Before and After Result: Well-Proportioned Body, Confidence Back

After her care for body and proportions in APEX Surgery Wars EP6, Khun Mes saw a clearer change, especially in her confidence about dressing. She used to hold back from wearing clothes that show her figure because she worried about her shape and stretch marks. Today she enjoys getting dressed much more.

blocks.alt: Khun Mes's reveal after her body contouring with APEX on Surgery Wars EP6

blocks.x: Khun Mes described how she felt after the change: “At first I didn't dare show it, because I had a lot of stretch marks. But today I can wear outfits that show my waist and figure. I'm slimmer, I feel quite light, and I feel more confident in my clothes. Now I even dare to wear outfits that show my belly button, because I'm so much more confident.”
Reactions From the People on Surgery Wars EP6
Khun Mes's change also impressed the others on the show. Khun Ong Khemarat, APEX's Master Celeb, who took part from the case selection stage, spoke about the result after her reveal:
“I never thought it could turn out like this. When I chose the case, I wanted to look after her because she had many problems, and at the same time it was a challenge for our medical team.”

Khun Lukkade Metinee, who is also a mother, spoke about how she felt after seeing Khun Mes's change: “I'm impressed. The body work is really wow. As a mother myself, I know it's not easy to bring your own beauty and confidence back. I understand how she feels and I'm so happy for her.”
Summary

For Khun Mes, what came back was a change in proportions, and also confidence in everyday life and in dressing. She thanked the medical team: “Thank you to all the doctors, especially my dad, Dr. Somboon. He has made my life better. Now I feel confident in whatever I wear.”

Khun Mes's case in APEX Surgery Wars EP6 clearly reflects the Confidence Comeback concept, because the change helped her feel good about herself again, dare to dress up, and live with more confidence once more.

war:7.title: APEX Surgery Wars EP7 Gives Khun Wanchai, a 59-Year-Old Uncle, a Younger, Fresher Look
war:7.seo: APEX Surgery Wars EP7 gives Khun Wanchai, 59, a younger look
war:7.desc: Khun Wanchai, a 59-year-old restaurant owner and APEX winner on Surgery Wars EP7, had care for his eyes, face, neck, skin and smile to look younger.

blocks.alt: APEX Surgery Wars EP7 gives Uncle Wanchai, 59, a younger and fresher look

blocks.x: APEX Surgery Wars EP7 came with the concepts Men's Eyes and FaceLift. It tells the story of Khun Wanchai, 59, who had drooping brows, loose upper eyelids, under-eye bags, and sagging in the face and neck. His care was planned from the eyes and facial structure to skin quality and the smile.
Khun Wanchai's Problems Before Joining the Show
For a shop owner or an executive, image and credibility matter when meeting people, especially the eyes, which are often the first thing the other person sees.
“When I talk business, people look at my eyes first. So I wanted them to look fresher and more energetic. I didn't want to change my face, I just wanted to look better in a natural way.”

blocks.alt: APEX Surgery Wars EP7 gives Khun Wanchai, a 59-year-old uncle, a younger and fresher look

blocks.x: Before treatment, Khun Wanchai had several areas to assess together: forehead wrinkles, drooping brows, drooping eyelids, under-eye bags, nasolabial folds, the shape of the chin, and sagging in the face and neck.
The APEX Medical Team Assessed His Treatment Together

Dr. Somboon Waiphrip explained that the main problem in this case was “a sagging face and neck bands”. It could not be fixed in the eyes alone. For the whole face to look consistent, the plan had to cover the forehead, temples and face, down to the neck.
Another detail the team took seriously was that Khun Wanchai is a man. Too much adjustment could change his character and original identity.

blocks.alt: Khun Wanchai before surgery with APEX on Surgery Wars

blocks.x: A First Surgery, and Nerves Before the Operating Room
Even though he had decided to join APEX Surgery Wars, this was Khun Wanchai's first surgery ever, so he was quite worried.
“I was worried whether it would go well. I've never had an operation in my whole life.” The mood before treatment mixed excitement with jokes from his family.

Khun Wanchai cheerfully told how he and his wife talked about general anaesthesia, which eased his worry before the procedure. Behind the surgery, APEX doctors from each specialty cared for Khun Wanchai under safety standards accredited by AACI, an international body.
The APEX Doctors Who Cared for Khun Wanchai on the Show

The APEX medical team assessed and planned Khun Wanchai's care together, covering the facial structure, eyes, skin quality and smile, so that the overall result points in the same direction. The doctors were:

items: Dr. Narong Bampoengpon (Dr. Dong, licence no. 35637)
Dr. Apichaya Thongdee (Dr. Ple, dental licence no. 12965)
Dr. Poranee Chatthani (Dr. Oeng, licence no. 57758)

blocks.x: The Surgery Program the APEX Team Carried Out for Khun Wanchai
The main goal of the surgery in this case was to correct the sagging of the structure and bring the different parts into harmony, without changing Khun Wanchai's identity. The details are as follows.
1. Adjusting the teeth and smile to suit the new face, with TDH Dental

Before surgery, Dr. Apichaya Thongdee (dental licence no. 12965), also known as Dr. Ple, and the dental team found that some of his teeth were uneven in shape and some were missing. They planned to adjust the details of the teeth and choose a shade that suits his new look.

blocks.alt: Khun Wanchai having veneers and dental care at TDH Dental

items: Veneers: E-Max ceramic veneers to adjust the shape and proportions of the teeth so they suit the face, and to make the overall smile look brighter.
E-Max crowns: where the dentist judged it necessary, E-Max crowns were used to restore teeth and make the smile continuous.

blocks.x: 2. Forehead lift and brow lift

Khun Wanchai often raised his brows while talking, partly because of a heavy feeling in his eyelids. After assessing the brow and forehead positions together, the team planned an endoscopic forehead lift and brow lift, with a temple lift so that the area around the eyes is consistent.
This lift deals with forehead wrinkles and also corrects the position of the upper tissue that adds to the heavy look of the eyes.
3. Upper eyelid surgery

Dr. Narong Bampoengpon (licence no. 35637), also known as Dr. Dong, handled the upper eyelids. He removed excess eyelid skin and designed a new eyelid crease with a double eyelid procedure that suits the original structure. This makes the eyes look more open, shows more of the iris and reduces the tired look, while keeping an eye shape that suits a man's face.
4. Lower eyelid surgery for under-eye bags

Another clear problem was bulging under-eye bags. The team planned to correct the fat in the lower eyelids with under-eye bag surgery, and to treat the tissue bands in the tear trough, so the transition between the lower eyelid and the cheek looks smoother.
5. Facelift and neck lift

Sagging in the cheeks and neck was the main problem in this case, so a facelift, neck lift and neck tightening were planned. Dr. Somboon Waiphrip (licence no. 22713) adjusts the cheek line, the face outline and the neck so they fit together, using an 11-point digital facial analysis before surgery to assess the position of the tissue and the proportions of the whole face together.
6. Fat grafting

After the sagging was dealt with, some areas had still lost volume with age. The fat grafting program used the patient's own fat in the areas the doctor assessed, so the transitions of the face look continuous and the hollow or tired look in some spots is reduced.
7. Silicone chin implant

The shape of the chin also affects facial balance, especially when seen together with the face outline and the neck. After assessing the proportions, a silicone chin implant was placed to bring the lower face line in step with the other elements.
8. Silicone implant for the nasolabial area

Khun Wanchai had fairly deep nasolabial folds. The team planned to treat this area together with the facelift and volume filling. Dr. Somboon explained, “We will make the nasolabial folds shallower”, so the middle of the face looks more continuous with the result of the lift.

blocks.alt: Khun Wanchai before and after surgery with APEX on Surgery Wars EP7

blocks.x: Skin Care Program After Surgery

Dr. Poranee Chatthani (licence no. 57758), also known as Dr. Oeng, explained that the skin of someone around 59 to 60 years old still goes through age-related changes such as lower elasticity, dryness and less collagen. An aesthetics program was therefore planned to look after skin quality alongside the surgery on his face.

items: Oligio: monopolar RF energy, 930 shots, to look after skin firmness and quality. The areas and energy levels were set according to the doctor's assessment.
Vitaran: 3 boxes, as part of the skin quality plan, focused on restoring the skin according to the problems assessed in each area.
Profhilo: 2 boxes, to look after hydration, elasticity and overall skin quality. This is another part that supports the results of the structural correction.
Filler injections: Filler Volift, 3 cc, in the positions needing extra volume, so the details of the face after surgery are better balanced.
Botox injections: Botox Allergan, 100 units, placed according to muscle activity and the positions the doctor assessed, to look after expression lines and facial details.

blocks.x: The Reveal Moment: From Uncle to “Oppa”

One of the big moments of the show was Khun Wanchai's Before and After reveal. Before it, the host, Khun Nui Thanawat, mentioned Khun Wanchai's childhood dream of becoming a star. When he was revealed, the studio filled with shouts of “wow”.

blocks.alt: APEX Surgery Wars EP7 turns Uncle Wanchai into an oppa

blocks.x: Khun Lukkade Metinee, the Master Celeb of APEX Surgery Wars EP7, said, “The oppa is here!” Several people on the show said his new look reminded them of a Hong Kong star. They saw a clear change but still felt he was the same person. Khun Lukkade also spoke about the direction of the result:
“Everything moves in the same direction... If you're going to do anything, I always cheer for keeping it natural.”
When the Change Affects How You See Life
Khun Wanchai admitted that surgery had hardly ever crossed his mind before. After joining the show, he saw it differently.
“Surgery was never in my head. When the doctors chose me, I learned that it relates to health and to the flaws of the body, and also to the psychology of having confidence in yourself.”

He also described his family's reaction. After his face looked younger, his wife teased him and they started courting each other again, while some customers at his noodle shop even greeted him wrongly, thinking he was the owner's son.
More Confidence, Still the Same Person

Before the show ended, Khun Wanchai thanked the APEX doctors and staff who cared for him throughout the process. For Khun Wanchai, Apex Surgery Wars gave him the chance to understand surgery and to love himself more.
“Even when people say ‘uncle’ gently, it stings. But I have APEX, who made me an oppa today.”

The program, the number of products, the surgical techniques and the results for Khun Wanchai are a treatment plan made for him alone. Anyone who is interested should be examined and assessed by a doctor to choose the approach that suits their facial structure, skin, health and wishes.
Summary

APEX Surgery Wars EP7 shows another side of surgery for men, in this case a 59-year-old. It did not aim to turn his face into a different person's. It focused on age-related problems so that the overall look improves and his original identity stays.

Follow the stories, real cases and the planning behind the treatment in the next Surgery Wars episodes to see which cases and changes come next. If you want surgery to refresh your image, you can come and consult the doctors at APEX for an assessment and a treatment plan made for you.

war:8.seo: APEX Surgery Wars EP8 reshapes Khun Yui's face and corrects a protruding jaw
war:8.desc: Khun Yui, a winner on APEX Surgery Wars EP8: jaw surgery for a protruding jaw and bite problem, plus rhinoplasty, fat grafting and skin care.

blocks.alt: APEX Surgery Wars EP8 reshapes Khun Yui's face structure and corrects a protruding jaw

blocks.x: APEX Surgery Wars EP8 is the case of Khun Yui Watchalee, 33. Her main concerns were a protruding lower jaw and a bite problem, along with a fairly flat mid-face, a nose that lacked dimension, and a face that lacked volume.

The APEX medical team therefore planned her care jointly between the surgery team, the dental team and the aesthetics team, to adjust the structure, the facial proportions and the skin quality, under the concept Surgery Beyond.
Khun Yui's Main Problems Before Joining the Show

blocks.alt: Khun Yui before her face reshaping on APEX Surgery Wars EP8

blocks.x: Khun Yui has had a protruding lower jaw since birth, which affects her face shape and her bite. She said that in secondary school she began visiting clinics to consult doctors, but some places would not take her case because it was difficult. On the show, the doctors said she has a Class III bite, which cannot be corrected with braces alone. They also found other areas to adjust, such as:

items: A fairly sunken nose that does not suit the face structure
A face that is fairly hollow and lacks volume
A prominent lower face because of the jaw line
The shape of the lips and some details could be balanced better

blocks.x: The APEX Doctors Who Cared for Khun Yui on Surgery Wars EP8

blocks.alt: The APEX and TDH Dental medical team who cared for Khun Yui's case

blocks.x: With several problems to treat, the surgery team, the dental team and the aesthetics team worked together on Khun Yui's case. The case was cared for jointly by doctors from several specialties, for example:

items: Dr. Somboon Waiphrip (licence no. 22713) from APEX
Dr. Ekkalak Thammasunthorn (Dr. Ek, licence no. 21330) from APEX
Dr. Poranee Chatthani (Dr. Oeng, licence no. 57758) from APEX
Dr. Ruangyot Onsaard (Dr. Ruang, dental licence no. 2677) from TDH Dental
Dr. Theerachai Kanoknateesawat (Dr. A-Long, dental licence no. 15833) from TDH Dental

blocks.x: Each team handled a different part, from the jaw, the bite and the braces to plastic surgery and skin work, so that the treatment plan stays connected through the whole case.
The Surgery Program to Adjust Facial Structure and Proportions
The treatment plan in Surgery Wars EP8 started by solving the structural problems, and then adjusted the finer details of the face so that each part fits together better.

blocks.alt: Before and After images of Khun Yui in APEX Surgery Wars EP8

blocks.x: 1. Upper and lower jaw surgery
Khun Yui was planned for surgery on both the upper and lower jaw to correct her bite and the position of her jaws. The doctors positioned the bones to fit the midline of the face and the bite better.

This part of the treatment has to be done together with an orthodontist, because after surgery the teeth still need to be adjusted step by step, so the bite settles into place according to the treatment plan.
2. Open rhinoplasty with rib cartilage

After the jaw structure was adjusted, the team assessed that the mid-face still lacked dimension. They planned an open rhinoplasty using rib cartilage to adjust the structure and add projection to the nose, so it fits the forehead and the lower face. With more dimension in the nose, the mid-face stands out more and fits the side profile better.
3. Silicone implant for the forehead

Khun Yui's forehead was flat in some parts, so a thin silicone sheet was used to add suitable fullness and create a continuous line between the forehead and the bridge of the nose. The aim is to add dimension to suit the new structure of the nose and face, and the forehead is not made very prominent.
4. Fat grafting to the face

Another problem was a face that was fairly hollow and lacked volume, especially around the eyes and the upper face. Fat grafting to the face was done to add suitable fullness, which reduces the hollow look and softens a face structure that was prominent.
5. Lip lift

The lips were another part of the lower face that the doctors adjusted together. A lip lift was done to define the Cupid's bow, to reshape the lips and add detail that fits the facial proportions after the structure was adjusted.
TDH Dental Team Cared for the Bite and Braces

Khun Yui's case involved both the jaw and the bite, so dental care was an important part of the plan and did not end with the surgery. Invisalign clear aligners were used to move the teeth gradually after surgery so they fit the new position of the jaws.
The doctors also said on the show that Khun Yui needs follow-up on her bite, and that dental implants and crowns will follow in a later step as appropriate, once the bone has healed and fused.
Skin Care and Facial Detail Program
After the main structure was corrected, aesthetics care was added to refine the skin, making it firmer, clearer and more glowing.

items: Lip filler: filler to refine the details and volume of the lips further, according to the doctor's assessment, so they fit the shape of the mouth and the facial proportions after surgery.
Vitaran: part of the skin quality plan. The doctor decides the positions and the number of sessions to suit Khun Yui's skin.
Pico All Mode: a Pico Laser program to look after skin problems and skin tone, using several modes according to the skin condition the doctor assessed.
Botox injections: 50 units, to look after the muscles and facial proportions in suitable positions according to the doctor's assessment.
IV Celebrity: a vitamin drip, used as part of Khun Yui's overall care program alongside her treatment and follow-up in other areas.

blocks.x: Khun Yui's Results on Surgery Wars EP8

After the Before and After images were revealed in the Surgery Wars EP8 studio, the host and the people on the show commented on Khun Yui's change, saying she looks beautiful and her face structure is more balanced.

blocks.alt: Khun Nara Crepe Katoey, Master Celeb, reacting to Khun Yui on EP8

blocks.x: Khun Nara Crepe Katoey, the Master Celeb for the APEX team, said, “Sis Yui, from misaligned teeth, APEX could do this! A woman with a crooked chin and protruding teeth is today a beautiful woman, a Korean woman. Amazing!” She also praised how bright Khun Yui looks and how much softer her face looks after the face structure was adjusted.
Khun Yui's Impressions After Surgery with APEX

Khun Yui said that after treatment, people around her noticed the change, and some did not even recognise her. She used to hold back from smiling with her teeth showing in photos. Now she can smile fully and feels more confident in herself.

blocks.alt: Khun Yui after treatment and face reshaping by the APEX medical team

blocks.x: Before the end, Khun Yui thanked the APEX team: “Thank you so much to the doctors, the medical team and all the nurses. You took very good care of me, much more than I expected. I felt reassured throughout my treatment. Thank you for fixing a problem I've had for so long, and for giving me much more than I imagined.”
Summary

Khun Yui's case in APEX Surgery Wars EP8 involved a protruding jaw, a bite problem, facial proportions and skin quality, so it needed joint planning by doctors from several specialties. The key point of this case was to assess the face as a whole and to set the order of treatment to suit Khun Yui's own structure.

If you are interested in facial structure surgery and looking after your beauty in every dimension, you can come and consult the doctors at APEX for an assessment of your face structure and a treatment plan made for you.
